installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
apk add --no-cache xz curl tar unzip
cd /mnt/server

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
# Publisher manifests use an intentionally small, flat subset of YAML. Match
# the exact archive ID and reject missing, duplicate or malformed SHA-256 data.
resolve_release() {
  category=$1 version=$2 archive=$3 default_version=$4 pinned=$5
  case "$version" in ''|*[!0-9A-Za-z.-]*|.*|*..*) echo 'Invalid release version' >&2; return 1;; esac
  case "$version" in [0-9]*) ;; *) echo 'Release version must begin with a digit' >&2; return 1;; esac
  test "${#version}" -le 40 || return 1
  if [ "$version" = "$default_version" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$pinned"; return; fi
  manifest=$(mktemp)
  if ! curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --max-time 60 --max-filesize 1048576 --retry 3 "https://cdn.openttd.org/${category}-releases/${version}/manifest.yaml" -o "$manifest"; then rm -f "$manifest"; return 1; fi
  digest=$(awk -v target="$archive" '
    /^- id: / {selected=($3==target); if(selected) matches++}
    selected && /^  sha256sum: / {digest=$2; found++}
    END {if(matches==1 && found==1) print digest; else exit 1}
  ' "$manifest") || { rm -f "$manifest"; return 1; }
  rm -f "$manifest"
  test "${#digest}" -eq 64 || return 1
  case "$digest" in *[!a-f0-9]*) return 1;; esac
  printf '%s\n' "$digest"
}

OPENTTD_VERSION=${OPENTTD_VERSION:-15.3}
OPENGFX_VERSION=${OPENGFX_VERSION:-8.0}
TTD_SHA=$(resolve_release openttd "$OPENTTD_VERSION" "openttd-$OPENTTD_VERSION-linux-generic-amd64.tar.xz" 15.3 f49eb25d61b00f8f4d332fee02b530ad75552d1efb8f2bb01e7ca5e6540fe059)
GFX_SHA=$(resolve_release opengfx "$OPENGFX_VERSION" "opengfx-$OPENGFX_VERSION-all.zip" 8.0 43a0c1dabf39cb865394f3a6cc36d4da5c10ecfaaf55652043104806810903be)
mkdir -p .voltra
cat > .voltra/openttd-start.sh <<'VOLTRA_OPENTTD_START'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
visibility=${SERVER_VISIBILITY:-auto}
case "$visibility" in
  auto) case "${srv_advertise:-${SRV_ADVERTISE:-false}}" in true) visibility=public;; false) visibility=local;; *) echo 'srv_advertise must be true or false' >&2; exit 1;; esac;;
  local|public|invite-only) ;;
  *) echo 'SERVER_VISIBILITY must be auto, local, public or invite-only' >&2; exit 1;;
esac
# Atomic managed-key update; retain all other settings, saves and comments.
test -f openttd.cfg && test ! -L openttd.cfg
tmp=$(mktemp ./openttd.cfg.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
awk -v value="$visibility" '
  function emit() { if(network && !written) {print "server_game_type = " value; written=1} }
  /^[ \t]*\[/ {emit(); network=($0 ~ /^[ \t]*\[network\][ \t]*$/); if(network) seen=1}
  network && /^[ \t]*server_game_type[ \t]*=/ {if(!written) print "server_game_type = " value; written=1; next}
  {print}
  END {emit(); if(!seen) print "[network]\nserver_game_type = " value}
' openttd.cfg > "$tmp"
chmod 600 "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" openttd.cfg
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
for saved in /home/container/.local/share/openttd/save/autosave/exit.sav /home/container/.openttd/save/autosave/exit.sav /home/container/save/autosave/exit.sav; do
  if [ -f "$saved" ]; then exec ./openttd -D -c openttd.cfg -g "$saved"; fi
done
exec ./openttd -D -c openttd.cfg

VOLTRA_OPENTTD_START
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --max-time 300 --retry 3 --output openttd-linux.tar.xz https://cdn.openttd.org/openttd-releases/${OPENTTD_VERSION}/openttd-${OPENTTD_VERSION}-linux-generic-amd64.tar.xz
printf '%s  %s\n' "$TTD_SHA" openttd-linux.tar.xz | sha256sum -c -
tar -xf openttd-linux.tar.xz --strip-components=1
rm openttd-linux.tar.xz
chmod +x openttd
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --max-time 300 --retry 3 --output opengfx.zip https://cdn.openttd.org/opengfx-releases/${OPENGFX_VERSION}/opengfx-${OPENGFX_VERSION}-all.zip
printf '%s  %s\n' "$GFX_SHA" opengfx.zip | sha256sum -c -
mkdir -p .voltra baseset

trap 'rm -rf "$gfx_stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
unzip -o opengfx.zip -d "$gfx_stage"
for archive in "$gfx_stage"/*.tar; do
 test -f "$archive"
 tar --strip-components=1 -C baseset -xf "$archive"
done
rm -rf "$gfx_stage"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
rm opengfx.zip
if [ ! -f openttd.cfg ]; then
 cat > openttd.cfg <<'CONFIG'
[network]
server_name = Voltra OpenTTD
server_port = 3979
server_game_type = local
[gui]
autosave_on_exit = true
CONFIG
fi

cat > .voltra/factorio-update-mods.sh <<'MODUPDATE'
#!/bin/bash
# Adapted from factoriotools/factorio-docker a2ea39d069563c3c61c837889e7e569fb95486ef.
# MIT license: FACTORIOTOOLS-LICENSE. Voltra changes use staged files, literal
# environment credentials, strict Factorio branches and required dependencies.
set -eou pipefail

FACTORIO_VERSION=$1
MOD_DIR=$2
USERNAME=${SERVER_USERNAME:-}
TOKEN=${SERVER_TOKEN:-}
UPDATE_IGNORE=${MOD_UPDATE_IGNORE:-}
declare -A VISITED SELECTED CONFLICTS
COUNT=0

MOD_BASE_URL="https://mods.factorio.com"

print_step()
{
  echo "$1"
}

print_success()
{
  echo "$1"
}

print_failure()
{
  echo "$1"
}

# Checks if the current game version satisfies the mod's minimum required version.
# Returns 1 if the game version is compatible with the mod, 0 if not
check_game_version() {
  local mod_required_version="$1"  # The minimum Factorio version required by the mod
  local current_game_version="$2"  # The current Factorio version

  local mod_major mod_minor game_major game_minor
  mod_major=$(echo "$mod_required_version" | cut -d '.' -f1)
  mod_minor=$(echo "$mod_required_version" | cut -d '.' -f2)
  game_major=$(echo "$current_game_version" | cut -d '.' -f1)
  game_minor=$(echo "$current_game_version" | cut -d '.' -f2)

  if [[ "$game_major.$game_minor" == "$mod_major.$mod_minor" ]]; then echo 1; else echo 0; fi
}

# Checks dependency string with provided version.
# Only checks for operator based string, ignoring everything else
# Returns 1 if check is ok, 0 if not
check_dependency_version()
{
  local dependency="$1"
  local mod_version="$2"

  if [[ "$dependency" =~ ^(\?|!|~|\(~\)) ]]; then
    echo 1
    return
  fi

  local condition
  condition=$(echo "$dependency" | grep -oE '(>=|<=|>|<|=) [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*' || true)

  if [[ -z "$condition" ]]; then
    echo 1
    return
  fi

  local operator required_version
  operator=$(echo "$condition" | awk '{print $1}')
  required_version=$(echo "$condition" | awk '{print $2}')

  case "$operator" in
    ">=")
      if [[ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$required_version" "$mod_version" | sort -V | head -n1)" == "$required_version" ]]; then
        echo 1
      else
        echo 0
      fi
      ;;
    ">")
      if [[ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$required_version" "$mod_version" | sort -V | head -n1)" == "$required_version" && "$required_version" != "$mod_version" ]]; then
        echo 1
      else
        echo 0
      fi
      ;;
    "<=")
      if [[ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$required_version" "$mod_version" | sort -V | tail -n1)" == "$required_version" ]]; then
        echo 1
      else
        echo 0
      fi
      ;;
    "<")
      if [[ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$required_version" "$mod_version" | sort -V | tail -n1)" == "$required_version" && "$required_version" != "$mod_version" ]]; then
        echo 1
      else
        echo 0
      fi
      ;;
    "=")
      if [[ "$mod_version" == "$required_version" ]]; then
        echo 1
      else
        echo 0
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo 0
      ;;
  esac
}

get_mod_info()
{
  local mod_info_json="$1"

  # Process mod releases from newest to oldest, looking for a compatible version
  while IFS= read -r mod_release_info; do
    local mod_version mod_factorio_version
    mod_version=$(echo "$mod_release_info" | jq -r ".version")
    mod_factorio_version=$(echo "$mod_release_info" | jq -r ".info_json.factorio_version")

    # Check if this mod version is compatible with our Factorio version
    # This prevents downloading mods that require a newer Factorio version (fixes #468)
    # and ensures backward compatibility (e.g., Factorio 2.0 can use 1.x mods) (fixes #517)
    if [[ $(check_game_version "$mod_factorio_version" "$FACTORIO_VERSION") == 0 ]]; then
      echo "  Skipping mod version $mod_version because of factorio version mismatch"  >&2
      continue
    fi

    if [[ -n "${REQUIRED_CONSTRAINT:-}" ]] && [[ $(check_dependency_version "$REQUIRED_CONSTRAINT" "$mod_version") != 1 ]]; then continue; fi
    # If we found 'dependencies' element, we also check versions there
    if [[ $(echo "$mod_release_info" | jq -e '.info_json | has("dependencies") and (.dependencies | length > 0)') == true ]]; then
      while IFS= read -r dependency; do

        # We only check for 'base' dependency
        if [[ "$dependency" == base* ]] && [[ $(check_dependency_version "$dependency" "$FACTORIO_VERSION") == 0 ]]; then
          echo "  Skipping mod version $mod_version, unsatisfied base dependency: $dependency" >&2
          continue 2
        fi

      done < <(echo "$mod_release_info" | jq -r '.info_json.dependencies[]')
    fi

    echo "$mod_release_info" | jq -j ".file_name, \";\", .download_url, \";\", .sha1"
    break

  done < <(echo "$mod_info_json" | jq -c ".releases|sort_by(.released_at)|reverse|.[]")
}

# Check if a mod should be ignored based on UPDATE_IGNORE environment variable
is_mod_ignored() {
  local mod_name="$1"
  
  # If UPDATE_IGNORE is not set or empty, don't ignore any mods
  if [[ -z "${UPDATE_IGNORE:-}" ]]; then
    return 1
  fi
  
  # Split the comma-separated list and check if mod_name is in it
  IFS=',' read -ra ignored_mods <<< "$UPDATE_IGNORE"
  for ignored_mod in "${ignored_mods[@]}"; do
    # Trim whitespace from ignored_mod
    ignored_mod=$(echo "$ignored_mod" | xargs)
    if [[ "$mod_name" == "$ignored_mod" ]]; then
      return 0
    fi
  done
  
  return 1
}

update_mod()
{
  local MOD_NAME MOD_NAME_ENCODED MOD_INFO_URL MOD_INFO_JSON MOD_INFO MOD_FILENAME MOD_URL MOD_SHA1 HTTP_STATUS FULL_URL file
  local REQUIRED_CONSTRAINT="${2:-}" dependency dep_name dep_version selected_version
  MOD_NAME="$1"
  [[ "$MOD_NAME" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ ]] || { print_failure 'Invalid mod name.'; return 1; }
  if is_mod_ignored "$MOD_NAME"; then
    local installed
    installed=$(printf '%s\n' "$MOD_DIR/${MOD_NAME}_"*.zip | sed -n "s|^.*/${MOD_NAME}_\\([0-9.]*\\)\\.zip$|\\1|p" | sort -V | tail -n1)
    [[ -n "$installed" && $(check_dependency_version "$REQUIRED_CONSTRAINT" "$installed") == 1 ]] || { print_failure "Pinned mod cannot satisfy dependency: $MOD_NAME"; return 1; }
    return 0
  fi
  if [[ -n "${VISITED[$MOD_NAME]:-}" ]]; then
    [[ $(check_dependency_version "$REQUIRED_CONSTRAINT" "${SELECTED[$MOD_NAME]}") == 1 ]] || { print_failure "Conflicting dependency: $MOD_NAME"; return 1; }
    return 0
  fi
  COUNT=$((COUNT+1)); [[ "$COUNT" -le 500 ]] || { print_failure 'Dependency limit exceeded.'; return 1; }
  MOD_NAME_ENCODED="${1// /%20}"

  print_step "Checking for update of mod $MOD_NAME for factorio $FACTORIO_VERSION ..."

  MOD_INFO_URL="$MOD_BASE_URL/api/mods/$MOD_NAME_ENCODED/full"
  MOD_INFO_JSON=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 120 "$MOD_INFO_URL") || return 1

  if ! echo "$MOD_INFO_JSON" | jq -e --arg name "$MOD_NAME" '.name == $name and (.releases | type == "array")' >/dev/null; then
    print_failure "Metadata unavailable for $MOD_NAME; installed mods preserved."
    return 1
  fi

  MOD_INFO=$(get_mod_info "$MOD_INFO_JSON")

  if [[ "$MOD_INFO" == "" ]]; then
    print_failure "  No compatible release or dependency version."
    return 1
  fi

  MOD_FILENAME=$(echo "$MOD_INFO" | cut -f1 -d";")
  MOD_URL=$(echo "$MOD_INFO" | cut -f2 -d";")
  MOD_SHA1=$(echo "$MOD_INFO" | cut -f3 -d";")

  if [[ $MOD_FILENAME == null ]]; then
    print_failure "  No compatible release."
    return 1
  fi

  [[ "$MOD_FILENAME" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+_[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.zip$ ]] && [[ "$MOD_URL" == /download/* ]] && [[ "$MOD_URL" != *'?'* ]] && [[ "$MOD_URL" != *'..'* ]] && [[ "$MOD_SHA1" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { print_failure 'Invalid release metadata.'; return 1; }
  selected_version=$(echo "$MOD_INFO_JSON" | jq -r --arg f "$MOD_FILENAME" '.releases[] | select(.file_name == $f) | .version')
  VISITED[$MOD_NAME]=1; SELECTED[$MOD_NAME]="$selected_version"
  while IFS= read -r dependency; do
    if [[ "$dependency" == '! '* ]]; then
      dep_name="${dependency#'! '}"; dep_name="${dep_name%% *}"
      CONFLICTS["$MOD_NAME|$dep_name"]=1
      if jq -e --arg name "$dep_name" 'any(.mods[]; .name == $name and .enabled)' "$MOD_DIR/mod-list.json" >/dev/null; then print_failure "Incompatible enabled mod: $dep_name"; return 1; fi
      continue
    fi
    if [[ "$dependency" == '? '* || "$dependency" == '(?) '* ]]; then
      dependency="${dependency#* }"; dep_name="${dependency%% *}"
      jq -e --arg name "$dep_name" 'any(.mods[]; .name == $name and .enabled)' "$MOD_DIR/mod-list.json" >/dev/null || continue
    fi
    dependency="${dependency#~ }"
    if [[ "$dependency" =~ ^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)([[:space:]]+((\>=|\<=|\>|\<|=)[[:space:]]+[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*))?$ ]]; then dep_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"; else print_failure 'Invalid dependency metadata.'; return 1; fi
    case "$dep_name" in
      base|space-age|quality|elevated-rails)
        [[ $(check_dependency_version "$dependency" "$FACTORIO_VERSION") == 1 ]] || { print_failure 'Builtin dependency version cannot be satisfied.'; return 1; } ;;
      *) update_mod "$dep_name" "$dependency" || return 1 ;;
    esac
    jq --arg name "$dep_name" 'if any(.mods[]; .name == $name) then .mods |= map(if .name == $name then .enabled=true else . end) else .mods += [{name:$name,enabled:true}] end' "$MOD_DIR/mod-list.json" > "$MOD_DIR/.mod-list.tmp" || return 1
    mv "$MOD_DIR/.mod-list.tmp" "$MOD_DIR/mod-list.json" || return 1
  done < <(echo "$MOD_INFO_JSON" | jq -r --arg f "$MOD_FILENAME" '.releases[] | select(.file_name == $f) | .info_json.dependencies[]?')
  if [[ -f $MOD_DIR/$MOD_FILENAME ]] && [[ $(sha1sum "$MOD_DIR/$MOD_FILENAME" | cut -d ' ' -f1) == "$MOD_SHA1" ]]; then
    print_success "  Already up-to-date."
    return 0
  fi

  print_step "  Downloading $MOD_FILENAME"
  [[ -n "$USERNAME" && -n "$TOKEN" ]] || { print_failure 'Mod downloads require a Factorio username and token.'; return 1; }
  # Credentials are supplied through curl config stdin, never process arguments.
  FULL_URL="$MOD_BASE_URL$MOD_URL"
  local download; download=$(mktemp "$MOD_DIR/.download.XXXXXX")
  local encoded_user encoded_token
  encoded_user=$(jq -rn 'env.SERVER_USERNAME | @uri') || return 1
  encoded_token=$(jq -rn 'env.SERVER_TOKEN | @uri') || return 1
  HTTP_STATUS=$(printf 'url = "%s?username=%s&token=%s"\n' "$FULL_URL" "$encoded_user" "$encoded_token" | curl --config - --get --silent --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 300 -L -w "%{http_code}" -o "$download") || { rm -f "$download"; return 1; }
  if [[ $HTTP_STATUS == 200 ]] && [[ $(sha1sum "$download" | cut -d ' ' -f1) == "$MOD_SHA1" ]]; then mv "$download" "$MOD_DIR/$MOD_FILENAME"; else rm -f "$download"; print_failure 'Mod download failed or checksum did not match; installed mods preserved.'; return 1; fi

  if [[ $HTTP_STATUS != 200 ]]; then
    print_failure "  Download failed: Code $HTTP_STATUS."
    rm -f "$MOD_DIR/$MOD_FILENAME"
    return 1
  fi

  if [[ ! -f $MOD_DIR/$MOD_FILENAME ]]; then
    print_failure "  Downloaded file missing!"
    return 1
  fi

  if ! [[ $(sha1sum "$MOD_DIR/$MOD_FILENAME") =~ $MOD_SHA1 ]]; then
    print_failure "  SHA1 mismatch!"
    rm -f "$MOD_DIR/$MOD_FILENAME"
    return 1
  fi

  print_success "  Download complete."

  for file in "$MOD_DIR/${MOD_NAME}_"*".zip"; do # wildcard does usually not work in quotes: https://unix.stackexchange.com/a/67761
    if [[ $file != $MOD_DIR/$MOD_FILENAME ]]; then
      print_success "  Deleting old version: $file"
      rm -f "$file"
    fi
  done

  return 0
}

# Entire-set staging keeps old versions intact on network/auth/hash failure.
[[ ! -L "$MOD_DIR" ]] || { print_failure 'Mod directory must not be a symlink.'; exit 1; }
ORIGINAL_MOD_DIR="$MOD_DIR"
STAGE=$(mktemp -d "${MOD_DIR%/*}/.mod-update.XXXXXX")
trap 'if [[ ! -d "$ORIGINAL_MOD_DIR" && -n "${BACKUP:-}" && -d "$BACKUP" ]]; then mv "$BACKUP" "$ORIGINAL_MOD_DIR"; fi; rm -rf -- "$STAGE"' EXIT
cp -a "$MOD_DIR/." "$STAGE/"
MOD_DIR="$STAGE"
# Process all enabled mods from mod-list.json, but skip built-in mods
# The Space Age DLC includes built-in mods (elevated-rails, quality, space-age) that should not be downloaded
if [[ -f $MOD_DIR/mod-list.json ]]; then
  jq -r ".mods|map(select(.enabled))|.[].name" "$MOD_DIR/mod-list.json" | { while read -r mod; do
    # Skip base mod and DLC built-in mods
    if [[ $mod != base ]] && [[ $mod != elevated-rails ]] && [[ $mod != quality ]] && [[ $mod != space-age ]]; then
      if is_mod_ignored "$mod"; then
        print_success "Skipping mod $mod (listed in UPDATE_IGNORE)"
      else
        update_mod "$mod" || exit 1
      fi
    fi
  done
  for pair in "${!CONFLICTS[@]}"; do
    left="${pair%%|*}"; right="${pair#*|}"
    if jq -e --arg a "$left" --arg b "$right" 'any(.mods[]; .name == $a and .enabled) and any(.mods[]; .name == $b and .enabled)' "$MOD_DIR/mod-list.json" >/dev/null; then print_failure 'Conflicting mods in resolved set.'; exit 1; fi
  done; }
fi

BACKUP="${ORIGINAL_MOD_DIR%/*}/.voltra/mod-backups/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)-$$"
mkdir -p "${BACKUP%/*}"
mv "$ORIGINAL_MOD_DIR" "$BACKUP"
if ! mv "$STAGE" "$ORIGINAL_MOD_DIR"; then mv "$BACKUP" "$ORIGINAL_MOD_DIR"; exit 1; fi
echo 'Mod update complete; previous mod set retained in .voltra/mod-backups.'

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Render managed native settings without shell interpolation, then exec Luanti."""
import os
import json
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path


def scalar(value, field):
    value = str(value)
    if any(c in value for c in '\r\n\x00') or value != value.strip() or value in ('{', '"""'):
        raise ValueError(field + ' must be a single literal line without surrounding whitespace or native delimiters')
    return value


def slug(value, field):
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}', value):
        raise ValueError(field + ' must contain only letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens')
    return value


def number(env, field, low, high):
    value = env.get(field, '')
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', value) or not low <= int(value) <= high:
        raise ValueError('Invalid ' + field)
    return str(int(value))


def settings(env):
    pairs = {
        'name': 'SERVER_ADMIN_NAME', 'server_name': 'SERVER_NAME',
        'server_description': 'SERVER_DESC', 'server_address': 'SERVER_DOMAIN',
        'server_url': 'SERVER_URL', 'serverlist_url': 'SERVER_LIST_URL',
        'motd': 'SERVER_MOTD', 'default_password': 'SERVER_PASSWORD',
    }
    result = {key: scalar(env.get(field, ''), field) for key, field in pairs.items()}
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,20}', result['name']):
        raise ValueError('Choose a valid SERVER_ADMIN_NAME, at most 20 characters')
    if not result['server_name']:
        raise ValueError('Choose SERVER_NAME')
    if env.get('SERVER_ANNOUNCE') not in ('true', 'false'):
        raise ValueError('SERVER_ANNOUNCE must be true or false')
    result.update(server_announce=env['SERVER_ANNOUNCE'],
                  max_users=number(env, 'SERVER_MAX_USERS', 1, 65535),
                  port=number(env, 'SERVER_PORT', 1, 65535),
                  default_game=slug(env.get('DEFAULT_GAME', ''), 'DEFAULT_GAME'),
                  bind_address='0.0.0.0')
    return result


def object_end(lines, index, kind):
    """Find the end of an existing native multiline value or nested group."""
    while index < len(lines):
        raw_line = lines[index].removesuffix('\n')
        line = lines[index].strip()
        index += 1
        if kind == '"""':
            if raw_line == '"""':
                return index
            continue
        if line == '}':
            return index
        if not line or line.startswith('#') or '=' not in line:
            continue
        value = line.split('=', 1)[1].strip()
        if value in ('{', '"""'):
            index = object_end(lines, index, value)
    raise ValueError('Unterminated native configuration object; existing file was retained')


def render(text, managed):
    for key, value in managed.items():
        scalar(value, key)
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    output, seen, index = [], set(), 0
    while index < len(lines):
        start = index
        line = lines[index]
        index += 1
        trimmed = line.strip()
        if not trimmed or trimmed.startswith('#') or '=' not in trimmed:
            output.append(line)
            continue
        key, value = (v.strip() for v in trimmed.split('=', 1))
        if value in ('{', '"""'):
            index = object_end(lines, index, value)
        if key in managed:
            if key not in seen:
                # Keep identical operator formatting and file bytes on reinstall/start.
                if value == managed[key] and index == start + 1:
                    output.append(line)
                else:
                    output.append(key + ' = ' + managed[key] + '\n')
                seen.add(key)
        else:
            output.extend(lines[start:index])
    missing = [key for key in managed if key not in seen]
    if missing and output and not output[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
        output.append('\n')
    output.extend(key + ' = ' + managed[key] + '\n' for key in missing)
    return ''.join(output)


def configure(path, managed):
    path = Path(path)
    old = path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else b''
    new = render(old.decode('utf-8'), managed).encode('utf-8')
    if old == new:
        return False
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.luanti-config-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as stream:
            stream.write(new)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        if path.exists():
            shutil.copy2(path, path.with_name(path.name + '.voltra-backup'))
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)
    return True


def prepare_admin(root, world, env):
    enabled = env.get('BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN', '1')
    if enabled not in ('0', '1'):
        raise ValueError('BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN must be 0 or 1')
    name = env['SERVER_ADMIN_NAME']
    directory = root / '.minetest/worlds' / world
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    password = scalar(env.get('SERVER_ADMIN_PASSWORD', ''), 'SERVER_ADMIN_PASSWORD')
    generated = not password
    if enabled == '1' and generated:
        receipt = directory / ('voltra-admin-password-' + name + '.json')
        if receipt.exists():
            data = json.loads(receipt.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            if data.get('name') != name or not isinstance(data.get('password'), str):
                raise ValueError('The existing generated administrator password file is invalid; restore it or choose an explicit password')
            password = scalar(data['password'], 'stored administrator password')
            if not password:
                raise ValueError('The stored administrator password is empty')
        else:
            password = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    data = dict(enabled=enabled == '1', name=name, password=password, generated=generated)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.luanti-admin-', dir=directory)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            json.dump(data, stream)
        os.replace(temporary, directory / '.voltra-admin-bootstrap.json')
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)
    mod = directory / 'worldmods/voltra_admin_bootstrap'
    mod.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (mod / 'mod.conf').write_text('name = voltra_admin_bootstrap\ndescription = Native administrator account bootstrap\n', encoding='utf-8')
    shutil.copyfile(root / '.voltra/luanti-admin.lua', mod / 'init.lua')


def launch(root, env):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    world = slug(env.get('WORLD_NAME', ''), 'WORLD_NAME')
    managed = settings(env)
    engine = root / '.voltra/luanti/bin/luantiserver'
    runtime_env = dict(env, LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(root / '.voltra/luanti-libs'))
    version = subprocess.run([str(engine), '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, env=runtime_env)
    if not version.stdout.startswith('Luanti 5.17.0 '):
        raise ValueError('The installed engine is not reviewed Luanti 5.17.0; reinstall this recipe')
    home = root / '.minetest'
    if not (home / 'games' / managed['default_game'] / 'game.conf').is_file():
        raise ValueError('Upload the selected game to .minetest/games/GAME_ID, including game.conf, or reinstall with community download enabled')
    (home / 'worlds').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (home / 'mods').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    configure(home / 'minetest.conf', managed)
    prepare_admin(root, world, env)
    child_env = dict(runtime_env, HOME=str(root), LUANTI_USER_PATH=str(home),
                     LUANTI_GAME_PATH=str(home / 'games'), MINETEST_GAME_PATH=str(home / 'games'),
                     VOLTRA_LUANTI_PLAIN_CONSOLE='1')
    child_env.setdefault('TERM', 'xterm')
    print('Reviewed runtime: ' + version.stdout.splitlines()[0], flush=True)
    os.chdir(root)
    os.execve(str(engine), [str(engine), '--port', managed['port'], '--gameid', managed['default_game'],
                           '--world', str(home / 'worlds' / world), '--terminal',
                           '--config', str(home / 'minetest.conf'), '--logfile', str(root / 'server.log')], child_env)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        launch(Path.cwd(), os.environ)
    except (ValueError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        # Validation errors only identify field names. Never dump the environment.
        if isinstance(error, ValueError):
            print('Luanti setup failed: ' + str(error), flush=True)
        else:
            print('Luanti setup failed. Inspect installed files and reinstall the reviewed recipe.', flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1)

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Install a ContentDB game once, with staged extraction and a release receipt."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import stat
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

ENGINE = (5, 17, 0)


def identifier(value, field):
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}', value):
        raise ValueError('Invalid ' + field)
    return value


def request(url):
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
    if parsed.scheme != 'https' or parsed.hostname not in ('content.luanti.org', 'cdn.content.luanti.org'):
        raise ValueError('ContentDB returned an unsupported download address')
    return urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Voltra-Luanti-Setup/1'}), timeout=30)


def get_json(url):
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            with request(url) as response:
                return json.load(response)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            if attempt == 2:
                raise ValueError('ContentDB metadata could not be read; existing games were retained') from None
            time.sleep(attempt + 1)


def version(bound):
    if bound is None:
        return None
    match = re.fullmatch(r'(\d+)\.(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:-dev)?', str(bound.get('name', '')))
    if not match:
        raise ValueError('ContentDB returned an unsupported engine version bound')
    return tuple(int(p or 0) for p in match.groups())


def compatible(release):
    low, high = version(release.get('min_minetest_version')), version(release.get('max_minetest_version'))
    return (low is None or low <= ENGINE) and (high is None or ENGINE <= high)


def select_release(author, name, requested, fetch=get_json):
    base = 'https://content.luanti.org/api/packages/' + author + '/' + name + '/'
    package = fetch(base)
    if package.get('type', '').lower() != 'game':
        raise ValueError('The selected ContentDB package is not a game')
    if requested:
        release = fetch(base + 'releases/' + str(requested) + '/')
        if release.get('id') != requested:
            raise ValueError('ContentDB returned a different game release')
        if not compatible(release):
            raise ValueError('The selected game release does not support Luanti 5.17.0')
    else:
        releases = fetch(base + 'releases/')
        if not isinstance(releases, list):
            raise ValueError('ContentDB returned invalid release metadata')
        matches = [r for r in releases if compatible(r)]
        if not matches:
            raise ValueError('No compatible game release exists for Luanti 5.17.0')
        release = max(matches, key=lambda r: int(r['id']))
    if not isinstance(release.get('id'), int) or release['id'] <= 0:
        raise ValueError('ContentDB returned an invalid release identifier')
    return release


def extract_game(archive, destination):
    """Reject links, traversal and ambiguous roots before writing any game files."""
    destination = Path(destination)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zipped:
        members = zipped.infolist()
        paths = []
        for member in members:
            name = member.filename
            path = PurePosixPath(name)
            if not name or '\\' in name or path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or ':' in name or '\x00' in name:
                raise ValueError('Unsafe path in ContentDB game archive')
            mode = member.external_attr >> 16
            if mode and stat.S_IFMT(mode) not in (0, stat.S_IFREG, stat.S_IFDIR):
                raise ValueError('Links and special files are not accepted in game archives')
            paths.append(path)
        roots = [p.parent for p in paths if p.name == 'game.conf']
        if len(roots) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Game archive must contain exactly one game.conf')
        root = roots[0]
        selected = [(m, p.relative_to(root)) for m, p in zip(members, paths) if p.is_relative_to(root)]
        total = sum(m.file_size for m, _ in selected)
        if total + 32 * 1024 * 1024 > shutil.disk_usage(destination.parent).free:
            raise ValueError('Insufficient free space to extract the game')
        written = set()
        for member, relative in selected:
            if relative == PurePosixPath('.'):
                continue
            key = str(relative)
            if key in written:
                raise ValueError('Duplicate path in game archive')
            written.add(key)
            target = destination.joinpath(*relative.parts)
            if member.is_dir():
                target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            else:
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with zipped.open(member) as source, target.open('xb') as output:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(source, output)
    if not (destination / 'game.conf').is_file():
        raise ValueError('No game configuration was extracted')


def install(root, env, fetch=get_json, open_url=request):
    root = Path(root)
    game = identifier(env.get('DEFAULT_GAME', ''), 'DEFAULT_GAME')
    destination = root / '.minetest/games' / game
    if destination.exists():
        if not (destination / 'game.conf').is_file():
            raise ValueError('Existing game directory has no game.conf; repair or select another game ID')
        print('Existing game retained, including operator modifications.', flush=True)
        return False
    if env.get('COMMUNITY_DOWNLOAD') == '0':
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        print('Manual game mode: upload the selected game, including game.conf, before starting.', flush=True)
        return False
    if env.get('COMMUNITY_DOWNLOAD') != '1':
        raise ValueError('COMMUNITY_DOWNLOAD must be 0 or 1')
    author = identifier(env.get('COMMUNITY_GAME_AUTOR', ''), 'COMMUNITY_GAME_AUTOR')
    name = identifier(env.get('COMMUNITY_GAME_NAME', ''), 'COMMUNITY_GAME_NAME')
    raw_release = env.get('COMMUNITY_GAME_RELEASE', '0')
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{1,12}', raw_release):
        raise ValueError('Invalid COMMUNITY_GAME_RELEASE')
    release = select_release(author, name, int(raw_release), fetch)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.luanti-game-', dir=destination.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        archive = stage / 'game.zip'
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        count = 0
        try:
            with open_url(release['url']) as response, archive.open('wb') as output:
                while True:
                    chunk = response.read(1024 * 1024)
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    output.write(chunk)
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    count += len(chunk)
        except OSError:
            raise ValueError('Game download failed; existing games were retained') from None
        if release.get('size') and count != int(release['size']):
            raise ValueError('Incomplete game download')
        if author.lower() in ('luanti', 'minetest') and name == 'minetest_game' and release['id'] == 38214:
            if digest.hexdigest() != '5b364f6b0cf31ec336319492e14106d932eb86b65a91ded99f4b25f4876519dc':
                raise ValueError('The reviewed Minetest Game archive checksum does not match')
        extracted = stage / 'game'
        extract_game(archive, extracted)
        receipt = {'author': author, 'name': name, 'release': release['id'], 'commit': release.get('commit'),
                   'archive_sha256': digest.hexdigest(), 'archive_bytes': count, 'engine': '5.17.0'}
        (extracted / '.voltra-contentdb.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        os.rename(extracted, destination)
    print('ContentDB game installed. Reinstall preserves this game and all worlds.', flush=True)
    return True


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        install('/mnt/server', os.environ)
    except (ValueError, OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile, KeyError, TypeError):
        print('Luanti game installation failed. Check package, release, game ID and available storage. Existing worlds and games were retained.', flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1)

        if (readable)

        timeval timeout{0, 100000};
        int available = select(readable ? STDIN_FILENO + 1 : 0,
                &descriptors, nullptr, nullptr, &timeout);
        if (available > 0 && readable && FD_ISSET(STDIN_FILENO, &descriptors)) {
            char chunk[1024];
            ssize_t count = read(STDIN_FILENO, chunk, sizeof(chunk));
            if (count == 0) {
                readable = false;
            } else if (count > 0) {
                input.append(chunk, static_cast<size_t>(count));
                size_t newline;
                while ((newline = input.find('\n')) != std::string::npos) {
                    std::string command = input.substr(0, newline);
                    input.erase(0, newline + 1);

                                new ChatEventChat(m_nick, utf8_to_wide(command)));

                    input.clear();
                    std::cout << "[Console] Incomplete input exceeded 64 KiB; discarded." << std::endl;
                }
            }
        }
        while (!m_chat_interface->outgoing_queue.empty()) {
            ChatEvent *event = m_chat_interface->outgoing_queue.pop_frontNoEx();

            switch (event->type) {

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Native RON settings and a supervised, line-oriented Veloren server process."""
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


def integer(env, key, minimum, maximum):
    value = env.get(key, '')
    if not value.isascii() or not value.isdigit() or not minimum <= int(value) <= maximum:
        raise ValueError('Invalid ' + key)
    return int(value)


def flag(env, key):
    if env.get(key) not in ('0', '1'):
        raise ValueError(key + ' must be 0 or 1')
    return env[key] == '1'


def change(kind, value):
    return dict(kind=kind, value=value)


def managed_settings(env):
    game_port = integer(env, 'SERVER_PORT', 1, 65535)
    name = env.get('SERVER_NAME', '')
    if not name.strip() or len(name) > 64 or any(c in name for c in '\r\n\x00'):
        raise ValueError('Choose a single-line SERVER_NAME of at most 64 characters')
    game = dict(server_name=change('string', name),
                max_players=change('integer', integer(env, 'MAX_PLAYERS', 1, 65535)))
    mode = env.get('AUTH_MODE')
    if mode not in ('official', 'offline'):
        raise ValueError('AUTH_MODE must be official or offline')
    authentication = env.get('AUTH_SERVER_URL', 'https://auth.veloren.net')
    if mode == 'official':
        url = urlsplit(authentication)
        if url.scheme != 'https' or not url.hostname or url.username or url.password or any(c in authentication for c in '\r\n\x00'):
            raise ValueError('AUTH_SERVER_URL must be an HTTPS address without credentials')
    game['auth_server_address'] = change('option_string', authentication if mode == 'official' else None)
    cli = dict(update_shutdown_grace_period_secs=change('integer', 5),
               shutdown_signals=change('raw', '[SIGUSR1, SIGTERM]'))
    if flag(env, 'MANAGE_NETWORK'):
        allocated = set()
        try:
            allocated = {int(p) for p in env.get('VOLTRA_ALLOCATED_PORTS', '').split(',') if p}
        except ValueError:
            raise ValueError('The allocated port list is invalid') from None
        if game_port not in allocated:
            raise ValueError('The primary game port must be an actual allocation')
        game['gameserver_protocols'] = change('raw', '[Tcp(address: "0.0.0.0:' + str(game_port) + '")]')
        query_port = integer(env, 'QUERY_PORT', 0, 65535) or game_port
        query_enabled = flag(env, 'QUERY_ENABLED')
        if query_enabled and query_port not in allocated:
            raise ValueError('QUERY_PORT must be allocated to this server')
        game['query_address'] = change('option_string', '0.0.0.0:' + str(query_port) if query_enabled else None)
        metrics_port = integer(env, 'METRICS_PORT', 1, 65535)
        public_metrics = flag(env, 'METRICS_PUBLIC')
        if metrics_port == game_port:
            raise ValueError('METRICS_PORT must differ from the TCP game port')
        if public_metrics and metrics_port not in allocated:
            raise ValueError('Public METRICS_PORT must be allocated to this server')
        address = ('0.0.0.0:' if public_metrics else '127.0.0.1:') + str(metrics_port)
        # Older nightlies use metrics_address; newer builds use the CLI web server.
        game['metrics_address'] = change('string', address)
        cli['web_address'] = change('string', address)
    return game, cli


def configure(root, env):
    game, cli = managed_settings(env)
    helper = root / '.voltra/voltra-ron-config'
    documents = [(root / 'userdata/server/server_config/settings.ron', game),
                 (root / 'userdata/server-cli/settings.ron', cli)]
    original = {path: path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else None for path, _ in documents}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.veloren-validate-', dir=root / '.voltra') as temporary:
        isolated = Path(temporary) / 'userdata'
        for path, changes in documents:
            candidate = isolated / path.relative_to(root / 'userdata')
            candidate.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if original[path] is not None:
                candidate.write_bytes(original[path])
            subprocess.run([str(helper), str(candidate)], input=json.dumps(changes), text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
        # This native subcommand loads both settings types, then exits before
        # constructing a game server. Its fresh administrator list is empty.
        # Offline lookup prevents external account requests. All writes stay in
        # the isolated userdata directory, never the operator's real world.
        validate_env = dict(env, VELOREN_USERDATA=str(isolated), VELOREN_ASSETS=str(root / 'assets'), RUST_LOG='info')
        result = subprocess.run([str(root / 'veloren-server-cli'), '--no-auth', 'admin', 'remove', 'VoltraConfigValidation'],
                                cwd=root, env=validate_env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace', timeout=30)
        output = result.stdout + result.stderr
        if result.returncode or fallback(output) or 'FATAL: Failed to parse' in output:
            raise ValueError('Native Veloren configuration validation failed; existing settings were not changed')
        if str(isolated) not in output:
            raise ValueError('The game did not confirm the isolated validation directory; existing settings were not changed')
        for path, _ in documents:
            current = path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else None
            if current != original[path]:
                raise ValueError('Configuration changed during validation; retry after finishing file edits')
        for path, changes in documents:
            subprocess.run([str(helper), str(path)], input=json.dumps(changes), text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)


def fallback(line):
    text = line.casefold()
    return 'failed to parse setting file' in text or 'falling back to default settings' in text


def launch(root, env):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    configure(root, env)
    child_env = dict(env, VELOREN_USERDATA=str(root / 'userdata'),
                     VELOREN_ASSETS=str(root / 'assets'))
    child = subprocess.Popen([str(root / 'veloren-server-cli')], cwd=root, env=child_env,
                             stdin=None, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                             text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace', start_new_session=True)
    stopping = False

    def stop(_number, _frame):
        nonlocal stopping
        if not stopping and child.poll() is None:
            stopping = True
            child.send_signal(signal.SIGUSR1)

    previous = {s: signal.signal(s, stop) for s in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT)}
    invalid = False
    try:
        for line in child.stdout:
            if fallback(line):
                invalid = True
                print('Veloren rejected its settings. Existing configuration and backups are retained; startup was stopped.', flush=True)
                stop(None, None)
                continue
            if not invalid:
                print(line, end='', flush=True)
        code = child.wait()
        return 1 if invalid else code
    finally:
        for number, handler in previous.items():
            signal.signal(number, handler)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        raise SystemExit(launch(Path.cwd(), os.environ))
    except (ValueError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        if isinstance(error, ValueError):
            print('Veloren setup failed: ' + str(error), flush=True)
        else:
            print('Veloren setup failed. Validate native RON settings and installed files; existing backups are retained.', flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1)

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Install a publisher-verified Veloren archive without changing userdata."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import shutil
import stat
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath


def checksum(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def download(url):
    return urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Voltra-Veloren-Setup/1'}), timeout=60)


def unpack(archive, destination):
    destination = Path(destination)
    assets = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zipped:
        for member in zipped.infolist():
            path = PurePosixPath(member.filename)
            if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or '\\' in member.filename or ':' in member.filename or '\x00' in member.filename:
                raise ValueError('Unsafe game archive path')
            if not path.parts or (path.parts[0] != 'assets' and str(path) not in ('veloren-server-cli', 'LICENSE')):
                continue
            mode = member.external_attr >> 16
            if mode and stat.S_IFMT(mode) not in (0, stat.S_IFREG, stat.S_IFDIR):
                raise ValueError('Game archive contains a link or special file')
            target = destination.joinpath(*path.parts)
            if member.is_dir():
                target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            else:
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with zipped.open(member) as source, target.open('xb') as output:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(source, output)
                if path.parts[0] == 'assets':
                    assets.append(str(path))
    if not (destination / 'veloren-server-cli').is_file() or not assets or not (destination / 'LICENSE').is_file():
        raise ValueError('Game archive is incomplete')
    (destination / 'veloren-server-cli').chmod(0o755)
    return assets


def install(root, builds, channel, architecture=None, opener=download):
    root = Path(root)
    arch = {'amd64': 'x86_64', 'x86_64': 'x86_64', 'arm64': 'aarch64', 'aarch64': 'aarch64'}.get(architecture or platform.machine())
    if channel not in builds or arch not in builds[channel]:
        raise ValueError('Unsupported Veloren channel or architecture')
    build = builds[channel][arch]
    meta = root / '.voltra/veloren-release.json'
    previous = json.loads(meta.read_text()) if meta.exists() else {}
    same = previous.get('sha256') == build['sha256'] and previous.get('architecture') == arch
    binary = root / 'veloren-server-cli'
    assets_complete = same and isinstance(previous.get('asset_files'), list) and previous['asset_files'] and all((root / path).is_file() for path in previous['asset_files'])
    if assets_complete and binary.is_file() and checksum(binary) == previous.get('binary_sha256'):
        print('Reviewed Veloren build retained, including operator asset changes.', flush=True)
        return False
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / '.voltra').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.veloren-install-', dir=root) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        archive = stage / 'release.zip'
        for attempt in range(3):
            try:
                with opener(build['url']) as source, archive.open('wb') as output:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(source, output, 1024 * 1024)
                break
            except OSError:
                if attempt == 2:
                    raise ValueError('Game download failed; installed files were retained') from None
                time.sleep(attempt + 1)
        if archive.stat().st_size != build['bytes'] or checksum(archive) != build['sha256']:
            raise ValueError('Publisher game archive checksum or size does not match')
        fresh = stage / 'game'
        files = unpack(archive, fresh)
        if same and (root / 'assets').is_dir():
            # Repair missing stock assets, preserving existing operator overrides.
            for name in files:
                target = root / name
                if not target.exists():
                    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()):
                        raise ValueError('Asset repair path escapes the server directory')
                    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    shutil.copy2(fresh / name, target)
            os.replace(fresh / 'veloren-server-cli', binary)
        else:
            backup = root / '.voltra/veloren-backups' / str(time.time_ns())
            backup.mkdir(parents=True)
            replaced, deployed = [], []
            try:
                for name in ('assets', 'veloren-server-cli', 'LICENSE'):
                    target = root / name
                    if target.exists():
                        os.replace(target, backup / name)
                        replaced.append(name)
                    os.replace(fresh / name, target)
                    deployed.append(name)
            except OSError:
                for name in reversed(deployed):
                    target = root / name
                    if target.is_dir():
                        shutil.rmtree(target)
                    elif target.exists():
                        target.unlink()
                for name in reversed(replaced):
                    os.replace(backup / name, root / name)
                raise
        receipt = dict(build, channel=channel, architecture=arch, asset_files=files, binary_sha256=checksum(binary))
        staged = stage / 'receipt.json'
        staged.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
        os.replace(staged, meta)
    print('Verified Veloren build installed. Existing userdata was retained.', flush=True)
    return True


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        root = Path('/mnt/server')
        builds = json.loads((root / '.voltra/veloren-builds.json').read_text())
        install(root, builds, os.environ.get('VERSION', ''))
    except (ValueError, OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile, KeyError, TypeError):
        print('Veloren installation failed. Check the selected build, archive integrity and available storage. Existing userdata was retained.', flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1)

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
use ron::value::RawValue;
use serde::de::{MapAccess, Visitor};
use serde::{Deserialize, Deserializer};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashSet};
use std::fmt;
use std::fs::{self, OpenOptions};
use std::io::{self, Read, Write};
use std::path::Path;

struct Name(String);
impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for Name {
    fn deserialize<D: Deserializer<'de>>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error> {
        struct Identifier;
        impl Visitor<'_> for Identifier {
            type Value = Name;
            fn expecting(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter) -> fmt::Result {
                f.write_str("a settings field")
            }
            fn visit_str<E: serde::de::Error>(self, value: &str) -> Result<Name, E> {
                Ok(Name(value.to_owned()))
            }
        }
        deserializer.deserialize_identifier(Identifier)
    }
}

struct Fields<'a>(Vec<(String, &'a RawValue)>);
impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for Fields<'de> {
    fn deserialize<D: Deserializer<'de>>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error> {
        struct Root;
        impl<'de> Visitor<'de> for Root {
            type Value = Fields<'de>;
            fn expecting(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter) -> fmt::Result {
                f.write_str("a RON settings struct")
            }
            fn visit_map<M: MapAccess<'de>>(self, mut map: M) -> Result<Self::Value, M::Error> {
                let mut fields = Vec::new();
                let mut names = HashSet::new();
                while let Some(Name(name)) = map.next_key::<Name>()? {
                    if !names.insert(name.clone()) {
                        return Err(serde::de::Error::custom("duplicate settings field"));
                    }
                    let value = map.next_value::<&RawValue>()?;
                    fields.push((name, value));
                }
                Ok(Fields(fields))
            }
        }
        deserializer.deserialize_struct("Settings", &[], Root)
    }
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "kind", content = "value", rename_all = "snake_case")]
enum Change {
    String(String),
    Integer(u64),
    Boolean(bool),
    OptionString(Option<String>),
    Raw(String),
}
impl Change {
    fn literal(&self) -> Result<String, String> {
        let encoded = match self {
            Self::String(value) => ron::ser::to_string(value),
            Self::Integer(value) => ron::ser::to_string(value),
            Self::Boolean(value) => ron::ser::to_string(value),
            Self::OptionString(value) => ron::ser::to_string(value),
            Self::Raw(value) => {
                RawValue::from_ron(value).map_err(|_| "Invalid managed RON literal")?;
                return Ok(value.clone());
            }
        };
        encoded.map_err(|_| "Cannot serialize managed RON value".to_owned())
    }
}

fn parse(source: &str) -> Result<(Fields<'_>, usize), String> {
    let mut deserializer =
        ron::Deserializer::from_str(source).map_err(|_| "Invalid RON settings")?;
    let fields = Fields::deserialize(&mut deserializer)
        .map_err(|_| "Invalid or duplicate RON settings fields")?;
    let end = source.len() - deserializer.remainder().len();
    deserializer
        .end()
        .map_err(|_| "Unexpected content after RON settings")?;
    if end == 0 || source.as_bytes()[end - 1] != b')' {
        return Err("Unsupported RON root settings layout".to_owned());
    }
    Ok((fields, end - 1))
}

fn render(source: &str, changes: &BTreeMap<String, Change>) -> Result<String, String> {
    let (fields, closing) = parse(source)?;
    let mut edits = Vec::new();
    let mut found = HashSet::new();
    let mut last_end = None;
    for (name, raw) in fields.0 {
        let literal = raw.trim().get_ron();
        let start = (literal.as_ptr() as usize)
            .checked_sub(source.as_ptr() as usize)
            .ok_or("RON field is not borrowed from its source")?;
        let end = start.checked_add(literal.len()).ok_or("Invalid RON span")?;
        if end > source.len() || !source.is_char_boundary(start) || !source.is_char_boundary(end) {
            return Err("Invalid RON field span".to_owned());
        }
        last_end = Some(end);
        if let Some(value) = changes.get(&name) {
            found.insert(name);
            let replacement = value.literal()?;
            if literal != replacement {
                edits.push((start, end, replacement));
            }
        }
    }
    let mut additions = Vec::new();
    for (name, value) in changes {
        if !name
            .chars()
            .enumerate()
            .all(|(i, c)| c == '_' || c.is_ascii_alphabetic() || (i > 0 && c.is_ascii_digit()))
            || name.is_empty()
        {
            return Err("Invalid managed field name".to_owned());
        }
        if !found.contains(name) {
            additions.push(format!("    {}: {}", name, value.literal()?));
        }
    }
    if !additions.is_empty() {
        let at = last_end.unwrap_or(closing);
        let prefix = if last_end.is_some() { ",\n" } else { "\n" };
        edits.push((at, at, format!("{}{}\n", prefix, additions.join(",\n"))));
    }
    edits.sort_by_key(|edit| std::cmp::Reverse(edit.0));
    let mut result = source.to_owned();
    for (start, end, replacement) in edits {
        result.replace_range(start..end, &replacement);
    }
    parse(&result)?;
    Ok(result)
}

fn update(path: &Path, changes: &BTreeMap<String, Change>) -> Result<bool, String> {
    let existed = path.exists();
    let source = if existed {
        fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|_| "Cannot read existing RON settings")?
    } else {
        "()\n".to_owned()
    };
    let result = render(&source, changes)?;
    if existed && result == source {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    let parent = path
        .parent()
        .filter(|p| !p.as_os_str().is_empty())
        .unwrap_or(Path::new("."));
    fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|_| "Cannot create settings directory")?;
    let temporary = parent.join(format!(".ron-update-{}.tmp", std::process::id()));
    let mut staged = false;
    let mut transaction = || -> Result<(), String> {
        let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
        options.write(true).create_new(true);
        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
            options.mode(0o600);
        }
        let mut file = options
            .open(&temporary)
            .map_err(|_| "Cannot stage RON settings")?;
        staged = true;
        file.write_all(result.as_bytes())
            .and_then(|_| file.sync_all())
            .map_err(|_| "Cannot write staged RON settings")?;
        drop(file);
        if existed {
            fs::copy(
                path,
                path.with_file_name(format!(
                    "{}.voltra-backup",
                    path.file_name()
                        .ok_or("Missing settings file name")?
                        .to_string_lossy()
                )),
            )
            .map_err(|_| "Cannot preserve settings backup")?;
        }
        fs::rename(&temporary, path).map_err(|_| "Cannot replace RON settings")?;
        Ok(())
    };
    let result = transaction();
    if result.is_err() && staged {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(&temporary);
    }
    result.map(|_| true)
}

fn run() -> Result<(), String> {
    let args: Vec<_> = std::env::args_os().skip(1).collect();
    if args.len() != 1 {
        return Err(
            "Usage: voltra-ron-config FILE, with managed changes as JSON on stdin".to_owned(),
        );
    }
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin()
        .take(4 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
        .read_to_string(&mut input)
        .map_err(|_| "Cannot read managed settings")?;
    if input.len() > 4 * 1024 * 1024 {
        return Err("Managed settings request is too large".to_owned());
    }
    let changes = serde_json::from_str(&input).map_err(|_| "Invalid managed settings request")?;
    let changed = update(Path::new(&args[0]), &changes)?;
    println!("{{\"changed\":{changed}}}");
    Ok(())
}

fn main() {
    if let Err(error) = run() {
        eprintln!("RON settings update failed: {error}. Existing settings were retained.");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

        assert!(result.contains("// keep"));
        assert!(result.contains("/* keep too */"));

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Shared checksum/staging/preservation for native tar-based game releases."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import shutil
import tarfile
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request


def sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1048576), b''):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def download(release, target, cache_root=None):
    if not release['url'].startswith('https://'):
        raise ValueError('Native release download requires HTTPS')
    # An installer may receive immutable public blobs copied into its own
    # volume before installation. Never link writable game data to a cache.
    if cache_root is None:
        managed = next((p for p in target.parents if p.name == '.voltra'), None)
        cache_root = managed / 'public-cache' if managed is not None else None
    if cache_root is not None:
        cache_root = Path(cache_root)
        digest = release.get('sha256', '')
        if len(digest) != 64 or any(c not in '0123456789abcdef' for c in digest):
            raise ValueError('Public native cache requires a SHA-256 identity')
        cached = cache_root / digest
        if cache_root.is_symlink() or cached.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError('Native public cache must not use symlinks')
        if cached.exists():
            if not cached.is_file() or (release.get('bytes') and cached.stat().st_size != release['bytes']) or sha256(cached) != digest:
                raise ValueError('Native public cache failed integrity validation')
            with cached.open('rb') as source, target.open('xb') as out:
                shutil.copyfileobj(source, out)
            if sha256(target) != digest:
                target.unlink()
                raise ValueError('Native cached copy failed integrity validation')
            print('Verified public native archive reused from cache.', flush=True)
            return
    with urllib.request.urlopen(release['url'], timeout=120) as source, target.open('xb') as out:
        shutil.copyfileobj(source, out)
    if release.get('bytes') and target.stat().st_size != release['bytes']:
        raise ValueError('Native archive size mismatch')
    if sha256(target) != release['sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Native archive checksum mismatch')


def extract(archive, target, prefix):
    seen, total = set(), 0
    with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:*') as source:
        for member in source:
            parts = PurePosixPath(member.name).parts
            if member.name.startswith('/') or '..' in parts or '\\' in member.name:
                raise ValueError('Unsafe native archive path')
            if prefix is not None:
                if not parts or parts[0] != prefix:
                    raise ValueError('Unexpected native archive prefix')
                if len(parts) == 1:
                    if not member.isdir():
                        raise ValueError('Native archive root must be a directory')
                    continue
                parts = parts[1:]
            elif not parts:
                if member.isdir() and member.name in ('.', './'):
                    continue
                raise ValueError('Empty native archive path')
            relative = PurePosixPath(*parts)
            if not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()) or str(relative) in seen:
                raise ValueError('Archive links, special files and duplicate paths are unsupported')
            seen.add(str(relative))
            total += member.size
            if len(seen) > 100000 or total > 4 * 1024**3:
                raise ValueError('Native archive exceeds extraction limits')
            path = target.joinpath(*relative.parts)
            if member.isdir():
                path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            else:
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with source.extractfile(member) as inp, path.open('xb') as out:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(inp, out)
                path.chmod(member.mode & 0o777)


def install_release(root, release, target_name, executable, defaults=None):
    root = root.resolve()
    state, target = root / '.voltra' / target_name, root / target_name
    if not state.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError('Native engine or state directory escapes the server volume')
    receipt = state / 'release.json'
    if receipt.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Native release receipt must not be a symbolic link')
    state.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    old = json.loads(receipt.read_text()) if receipt.is_file() else {}
    binary = target / executable
    if old.get('sha256') == release['sha256'] and binary.is_file() and sha256(binary) == old.get('binary_sha256') and all((target / name).is_file() for name in old.get('files', {})):
        print('Native release ' + release['version'] + ' and operator files retained.', flush=True)
        return
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.stage-', dir=state) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        download(release, stage / 'archive')
        ready = stage / 'ready'
        ready.mkdir()
        extract(stage / 'archive', ready, release['prefix'])
        if not (ready / executable).is_file():
            raise ValueError('Native archive is missing the server executable')
        for name, text in (defaults or {}).items():
            if not (target / name).exists():
                (ready / name).write_text(text)
        files = {p.relative_to(ready).as_posix(): sha256(p) for p in ready.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
        backup = state / ('previous-' + str(time.time_ns()))
        replacements = []
        try:
            for name, expected in files.items():
                source, destination = ready / name, target / name
                if not destination.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
                    raise ValueError('Native destination escapes the server volume')
                if destination.exists():
                    # Configuration and maps always remain operator-owned. Other
                    # modified stock assets remain overrides across updates.
                    preserve = name.endswith('.cfg') or name.startswith(('data/maps/', 'data/maps7/', 'maps/'))
                    preserve |= name != executable and (name not in old.get('files', {}) or sha256(destination) != old['files'][name])
                    if preserve:
                        continue
                    saved = backup / name
                    saved.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    shutil.copy2(destination, saved)
                else:
                    saved = None
                destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                os.replace(source, destination)
                replacements.append((destination, saved))
            staged = stage / 'receipt.json'
            staged.write_text(json.dumps({**release, 'binary_sha256': sha256(binary), 'files': files}, indent=2) + '\n')
            os.replace(staged, receipt)
        except BaseException:
            for destination, saved in reversed(replacements):
                if saved is None:
                    destination.unlink()
                else:
                    os.replace(saved, destination)
            raise
    print('Native release ' + release['version'] + ' installed; operator files preserved.', flush=True)
VOLTRA_SOURCE

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. ZIP companion to the shared native tar-release checksum/cache contract."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import shutil
import stat
import tempfile
import time
import zipfile
from native_release import download, sha256


def extract(archive, target, prefix, paths=None):
    seen, total = set(), 0
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as source:
        for member in source.infolist():
            parts = PurePosixPath(member.filename).parts
            mode = member.external_attr >> 16
            if not parts or member.filename.startswith('/') or '..' in parts or '\\' in member.filename:
                raise ValueError('Unsafe ZIP release path')
            if prefix is not None:
                if parts[0] != prefix:
                    raise ValueError('Unexpected ZIP release prefix')
                if len(parts) == 1:
                    if not member.is_dir():
                        raise ValueError('ZIP release root must be a directory')
                    continue
                parts = parts[1:]
            relative = PurePosixPath(*parts)
            name = relative.as_posix()
            kind = stat.S_IFMT(mode)
            if kind not in (0, stat.S_IFDIR, stat.S_IFREG) or str(relative) in seen:
                raise ValueError('ZIP links, special files or duplicate paths are unsupported')
            seen.add(str(relative))
            total += member.file_size
            if len(seen) > 100000 or total > 4 * 1024**3:
                raise ValueError('ZIP release exceeds extraction limits')
            if paths is not None and not any(name == selected or selected.endswith('/') and name.startswith(selected) for selected in paths):
                continue
            path = target.joinpath(*relative.parts)
            if member.is_dir():
                path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            else:
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with source.open(member) as inp, path.open('xb') as out:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(inp, out)
                path.chmod((mode & 0o777) or 0o644)


def install_release(root, release, target_name, executable):

def quoted(value, limit, info=False):

        raise ValueError('Native OpenArena values cannot contain quotes, line breaks or NUL, and must fit the byte limit')
    if info and any(c in value for c in '\\;'):

        if (folder / 'maps' / (name + '.bsp')).is_file():
            return True
        for package in folder.glob('*.pk3'):
            with zipfile.ZipFile(package) as archive:
                if 'maps/' + name + '.bsp' in archive.namelist():

from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import stat
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.request

BOOTSTRAP = 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz'


@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    if root.resolve() != root or root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')
    descriptor = os.open(root, flags)
    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)
    try:
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    yield None, parts[-1], volume
                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                try:
                    if os.geteuid() == 0:
                        os.fchown(next_descriptor, volume.st_uid, volume.st_gid)
                except BaseException:
                    os.close(next_descriptor)
                    raise
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = next_descriptor
        yield descriptor, parts[-1], volume
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _publication_leaf(parent, name):
    try:
        metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise ValueError('Steam publication destination must be a regular file')
    return metadata


def _publication_check(root):
    # Run before bootstrap/SteamCMD and again after the publisher, including
    # missing leaves: existing parent components must still be confined.
    for relative in ('.voltra/steam-template-release.json',
                     '.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so', '.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):
        with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is not None:
                _publication_leaf(parent, name)


def _publish(root, relative, writer, default_mode=0o644):
    """Publish new bytes while retaining existing ownership and permissions."""
    with _publication_parent(root, relative, create=True) as (parent, name, volume):
        previous = _publication_leaf(parent, name)
        temporary, descriptor, identity = None, None, None
        try:
            for attempt in range(5):
                candidate = '.voltra-publish-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
                try:

                    continue

                raise ValueError('Cannot reserve a private Steam publication file')
            identity = os.fstat(descriptor)

                writer(output)
                output.flush()

            if os.geteuid() == 0:

            os.fchmod(descriptor, stat.S_IMODE(previous.st_mode) if previous else default_mode)
            os.fsync(descriptor)

                if current is None or (os.fstat(current).st_dev, os.fstat(current).st_ino) != (os.fstat(parent).st_dev, os.fstat(parent).st_ino):

    expected = ("ERROR! Failed to install app '" + str(app_id) + "' (Invalid platform)").encode('ascii')

def manifest(root, app_id):
    path = root / 'steamapps' / ('appmanifest_' + str(app_id) + '.acf')
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    values = {}
    for key in ('appid', 'StateFlags', 'buildid'):
        matches = re.findall(r'"' + key + r'"\s+"([0-9]+)"', text)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Steam manifest is missing an unambiguous ' + key)
        values[key] = int(matches[0])
    if values['appid'] != app_id or values['StateFlags'] != 4 or values['buildid'] < 1:
        raise ValueError('Steam did not leave a fully installed application manifest')
    return values


class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output


def bootstrap(root):
    target = root / '.voltra/steamcmd'

        return

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.steam-bootstrap-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        archive = stage / 'steamcmd.tar.gz'
        checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        with urllib.request.urlopen(BOOTSTRAP, timeout=120) as response, archive.open('xb') as output:
            if not response.geturl().startswith('https://'):
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap redirected outside HTTPS')
            while True:
                block = response.read(1048576)
                if not block:
                    break
                count += len(block)
                if count > 128 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap archive exceeds its size limit')
                checksum.update(block)
                output.write(block)
        ready = stage / 'ready'; ready.mkdir()
        seen, total = set(), 0
        with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:gz') as source:
            for member in source:
                path = PurePosixPath(member.name)
                if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or '\\' in member.name or not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()):
                    raise ValueError('Unsafe SteamCMD bootstrap archive')
                if path.as_posix() == '.':
                    continue
                if path.as_posix() in seen:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate SteamCMD bootstrap path')
                seen.add(path.as_posix()); total += member.size
                if len(seen) > 10000 or total > 512 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap expansion exceeds its limit')
                destination = ready.joinpath(*path.parts)
                if member.isdir():
                    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    with source.extractfile(member) as inp, destination.open('xb') as output:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(inp, output)
                    destination.chmod(member.mode & 0o777)

            if not (ready / name).is_file():
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap is missing its launcher')
            (ready / name).chmod(0o755)
        if target.exists():
            raise ValueError('Incomplete existing SteamCMD folder needs operator review')
        os.replace(ready, target)
        (target.parent / 'steamcmd-bootstrap.json').write_text(json.dumps({'url': BOOTSTRAP, 'sha256': checksum.hexdigest(), 'bytes': count}) + '\n')

    root = root.resolve()
    env = os.environ if env is None else env
    args = arguments(root, app_id, env, validate, platform=platform, force_platform=force_platform)
    if supplied_root != root:
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume must not contain symlinks or traversal')
    _publication_check(root)
    bootstrap(root)
    _publication_check(root)

    for name in ('PYTHONHOME', 'PYTHONPATH', 'LD_PRELOAD'):
        child_env.pop(name, None)
    # The bundled Python dependency directory belongs to the helper only.
    child_env.pop('LD_LIBRARY_PATH', None)
    print('SteamCMD: refresh target metadata, then ' + ('validate/install' if validate else 'update') + ' application ' + str(app_id), flush=True)
    child = subprocess.Popen(['timeout', '--signal=TERM', '--kill-after=30s', '7200s', *args], cwd=root, env=child_env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)

        status = child.wait()
    except BaseException:
        child.terminate()

        # contain Steam credentials. Never let that exception reach the console.
        raise RuntimeError('Steam helper interrupted; inspect the redacted output') from None
    if status != 0:
        raise SteamInstallError(app_id, status, failure_reason(failure_tail, app_id))
    _publication_check(root)
    receipt = manifest(root, app_id)
    for name in required:
        path = root / name
        if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:

            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'rb') as source:
                metadata = os.fstat(source.fileno())

                         lambda output: shutil.copyfileobj(source, output), metadata.st_mode & 0o777)
    payload = (json.dumps({**receipt, 'branch': env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '') or 'public', 'platform': platform}, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
    _publish(root, '.voltra/steam-template-release.json', lambda output: output.write(payload))
    return receipt

import json
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re

import sys
import sysconfig

def bundle(root):

        raise ValueError('Python bundle escapes the server volume')
