#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Shared SteamCMD contract for imported game templates, without shell flags."""
import hashlib
from contextlib import contextmanager
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import stat
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.request

BOOTSTRAP = 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz'


@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    if root.resolve() != root or root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')
    descriptor = os.open(root, flags)
    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)
    try:
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    yield None, parts[-1], volume
                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                try:
                    if os.geteuid() == 0:
                        os.fchown(next_descriptor, volume.st_uid, volume.st_gid)
                except BaseException:
                    os.close(next_descriptor)
                    raise
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = next_descriptor
        yield descriptor, parts[-1], volume
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _publication_leaf(parent, name):
    try:
        metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise ValueError('Steam publication destination must be a regular file')
    return metadata


def _publication_check(root):
    # Run before bootstrap/SteamCMD and again after the publisher, including
    # missing leaves: existing parent components must still be confined.
    for relative in ('.voltra/steam-template-release.json',
                     '.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so', '.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):
        with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is not None:
                _publication_leaf(parent, name)


def _publish(root, relative, writer, default_mode=0o644):
    """Publish new bytes while retaining existing ownership and permissions."""
    with _publication_parent(root, relative, create=True) as (parent, name, volume):
        previous = _publication_leaf(parent, name)
        temporary, descriptor, identity = None, None, None
        try:
            for attempt in range(5):
                candidate = '.voltra-publish-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
                try:
                    descriptor = os.open(candidate, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                                         0o600, dir_fd=parent)
                    temporary = candidate
                    break
                except FileExistsError:
                    continue
            if descriptor is None:
                raise ValueError('Cannot reserve a private Steam publication file')
            identity = os.fstat(descriptor)
            with os.fdopen(os.dup(descriptor), 'wb') as output:
                writer(output)
                output.flush()
            metadata = previous or volume
            if os.geteuid() == 0:
                os.fchown(descriptor, metadata.st_uid, metadata.st_gid)
            os.fchmod(descriptor, stat.S_IMODE(previous.st_mode) if previous else default_mode)
            os.fsync(descriptor)
            with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (current, leaf, _):
                if current is None or (os.fstat(current).st_dev, os.fstat(current).st_ino) != (os.fstat(parent).st_dev, os.fstat(parent).st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication parent changed')
                latest = _publication_leaf(current, leaf)
                signature = lambda value: None if value is None else (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_mode, value.st_uid, value.st_gid, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)
                if signature(latest) != signature(previous):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication destination changed')
                candidate = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                if (candidate.st_dev, candidate.st_ino) != (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication temporary file changed')
                os.replace(temporary, name, src_dir_fd=parent, dst_dir_fd=parent)
                temporary = None
                os.fsync(parent)
            _publication_check(root)
        finally:
            if temporary is not None and identity is not None:
                # Remove only the inode reserved by this invocation. A replaced
                # or unknown name is never deleted as failure cleanup.
                try:
                    current = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                    if (current.st_dev, current.st_ino) == (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):
                        os.unlink(temporary, dir_fd=parent)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass
            if descriptor is not None:
                os.close(descriptor)


class SteamInstallError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, app_id, status, reason):
        self.app_id, self.status, self.reason = app_id, status, reason
        super().__init__('SteamCMD failed (' + reason + '); inspect the redacted installation output')


def failure_reason(output, app_id):
    clean = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', b'', output)
    expected = ("ERROR! Failed to install app '" + str(app_id) + "' (Invalid platform)").encode('ascii')
    return 'invalid_platform' if any(line.strip() == expected for line in clean.splitlines()) else 'steamcmd_failed'


def arguments(root, app_id, env, validate=True, platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    # SteamCMD reparses its argv using its own command language. Raw argv is
    # therefore not a faithful credential transport (e.g. a leading + value
    # becomes another command). Keep unverified private paths unavailable.
    if (env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '') or env.get('STEAM_PASS', '') or
            env.get('STEAM_AUTH', '') or env.get('STEAM_USER', '') not in ('', 'anonymous')):
        raise ValueError('Private Steam credentials are not enabled until native command parsing is verified')
    if not isinstance(app_id, int) or isinstance(app_id, bool) or not 1 <= app_id <= 2**31 - 1:
        raise ValueError('Choose a numeric Steam application ID')
    branch = env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '')
    if branch and not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}', branch):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam branch name')
    credentials = [env.get(name, '') for name in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH')]
    if any(value.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in value) for value in credentials):
        raise ValueError('Steam credentials cannot contain controls or begin with command prefixes')
    if credentials[0] and credentials[0] != 'anonymous':
        if not credentials[1]:
            raise ValueError('A Steam account password is required for account login')
        login = credentials[:2] + ([credentials[2]] if credentials[2] else [])
    else:
        login = ['anonymous']
    if platform not in ('linux', 'windows'):
        raise ValueError('Choose a reviewed Steam target platform')
    if not isinstance(force_platform, bool): raise ValueError('Platform selection must be an explicit boolean')
    if env.get('WINDOWS_INSTALL', '1' if platform == 'windows' else '0') != ('1' if platform == 'windows' else '0'):
        raise ValueError('Steam target platform does not match this reviewed template')
    args = [str(root / '.voltra/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh'), '+@ShutdownOnFailedCommand', '1',
            '+@NoPromptForPassword', '1', '+force_install_dir', str(root)]
    if platform == 'windows' or force_platform:
        args += ['+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType', platform]
    args += ['+login', *login,
            # Required for first installs in a cold SteamCMD metadata cache.
            '+app_info_update', '1', '+app_info_print', str(app_id)]
    if app_id == 90:
        game = env.get('HLDS_GAME', 'cstrike')
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,32}', game):
            raise ValueError('Choose a native HLDS mod directory')
        args += ['+app_set_config', '90', 'mod', game]
    args += ['+app_update', str(app_id)]
    if branch and branch != 'public':
        args += ['-beta', branch]
    beta_password = env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '')
    if beta_password:
        if not branch or branch == 'public' or beta_password.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in beta_password):
            raise ValueError('A beta password requires a selected private branch')
        args += ['-betapassword', beta_password]
    if env.get('INSTALL_FLAGS', ''):
        raise ValueError('Use typed Steam options instead of arbitrary INSTALL_FLAGS')
    if validate:
        args += ['validate']
    return args + ['+quit']


def manifest(root, app_id):
    path = root / 'steamapps' / ('appmanifest_' + str(app_id) + '.acf')
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    values = {}
    for key in ('appid', 'StateFlags', 'buildid'):
        matches = re.findall(r'"' + key + r'"\s+"([0-9]+)"', text)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Steam manifest is missing an unambiguous ' + key)
        values[key] = int(matches[0])
    if values['appid'] != app_id or values['StateFlags'] != 4 or values['buildid'] < 1:
        raise ValueError('Steam did not leave a fully installed application manifest')
    return values


class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output


def bootstrap(root):
    target = root / '.voltra/steamcmd'
    if target.is_symlink() or not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError('SteamCMD destination escapes the server volume')
    if (target / 'steamcmd.sh').is_file() and (target / 'linux32/steamcmd').is_file():
        return
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.steam-bootstrap-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        archive = stage / 'steamcmd.tar.gz'
        checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        with urllib.request.urlopen(BOOTSTRAP, timeout=120) as response, archive.open('xb') as output:
            if not response.geturl().startswith('https://'):
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap redirected outside HTTPS')
            while True:
                block = response.read(1048576)
                if not block:
                    break
                count += len(block)
                if count > 128 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap archive exceeds its size limit')
                checksum.update(block)
                output.write(block)
        ready = stage / 'ready'; ready.mkdir()
        seen, total = set(), 0
        with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:gz') as source:
            for member in source:
                path = PurePosixPath(member.name)
                if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or '\\' in member.name or not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()):
                    raise ValueError('Unsafe SteamCMD bootstrap archive')
                if path.as_posix() == '.':
                    continue
                if path.as_posix() in seen:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate SteamCMD bootstrap path')
                seen.add(path.as_posix()); total += member.size
                if len(seen) > 10000 or total > 512 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap expansion exceeds its limit')
                destination = ready.joinpath(*path.parts)
                if member.isdir():
                    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    with source.extractfile(member) as inp, destination.open('xb') as output:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(inp, output)
                    destination.chmod(member.mode & 0o777)
        for name in ('steamcmd.sh', 'linux32/steamcmd'):
            if not (ready / name).is_file():
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap is missing its launcher')
            (ready / name).chmod(0o755)
        if target.exists():
            raise ValueError('Incomplete existing SteamCMD folder needs operator review')
        os.replace(ready, target)
        (target.parent / 'steamcmd-bootstrap.json').write_text(json.dumps({'url': BOOTSTRAP, 'sha256': checksum.hexdigest(), 'bytes': count}) + '\n')


def update(root, app_id, env=None, validate=True, required=(), platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    supplied_root = root.absolute()
    root = root.resolve()
    env = os.environ if env is None else env
    args = arguments(root, app_id, env, validate, platform=platform, force_platform=force_platform)
    if supplied_root != root:
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume must not contain symlinks or traversal')
    _publication_check(root)
    bootstrap(root)
    _publication_check(root)
    child_env = {**os.environ, 'HOME': str(root)}
    for name in ('PYTHONHOME', 'PYTHONPATH', 'LD_PRELOAD'):
        child_env.pop(name, None)
    # The bundled Python dependency directory belongs to the helper only.
    child_env.pop('LD_LIBRARY_PATH', None)
    print('SteamCMD: refresh target metadata, then ' + ('validate/install' if validate else 'update') + ' application ' + str(app_id), flush=True)
    child = subprocess.Popen(['timeout', '--signal=TERM', '--kill-after=30s', '7200s', *args], cwd=root, env=child_env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    secrets = [env.get(key, '') for key in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH', 'SRCDS_BETAPASS')]
    redactor = Redactor(secrets)
    failure_tail = b''
    import sys
    try:
        while True:
            block = child.stdout.read1(16384)
            if not block:
                break
            failure_tail = (failure_tail + block)[-8192:]
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(redactor.feed(block)); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(redactor.feed(b'', final=True)); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        status = child.wait()
    except BaseException:
        child.terminate()
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            child.kill()
            child.wait()
        # TimeoutExpired includes the original command arguments, which can
        # contain Steam credentials. Never let that exception reach the console.
        raise RuntimeError('Steam helper interrupted; inspect the redacted output') from None
    if status != 0:
        raise SteamInstallError(app_id, status, failure_reason(failure_tail, app_id))
    _publication_check(root)
    receipt = manifest(root, app_id)
    for name in required:
        path = root / name
        if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
            raise ValueError('Steam installation lacks a required server file')
    for bits in ('32', '64'):
        with _publication_parent(root, '.voltra/steamcmd/linux' + bits + '/steamclient.so') as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is None or _publication_leaf(parent, name) is None:
                continue
            descriptor = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'rb') as source:
                metadata = os.fstat(source.fileno())
                if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
                    raise ValueError('Steam SDK source must be a regular file')
                _publish(root, '.steam/sdk' + bits + '/steamclient.so',
                         lambda output: shutil.copyfileobj(source, output), metadata.st_mode & 0o777)
    payload = (json.dumps({**receipt, 'branch': env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '') or 'public', 'platform': platform}, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
    _publish(root, '.voltra/steam-template-release.json', lambda output: output.write(payload))
    return receipt

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Bundle installed Debian Python for the matching Debian Steam runtime.

Run inside the Debian installer, after apt installed python3. The runtime image
must use the same Debian major release. Keep package notices beside the bundle.
"""
import json
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import sysconfig
import tempfile
import time


def bundle(root):
    root = root.resolve()
    target = root / '.voltra/python'
    if not target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or target.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Python bundle escapes the server volume')
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    packages = subprocess.check_output(['dpkg-query', '-W', '-f=${binary:Package}\t${Version}\n'], text=True)
    identity = {'python': sys.version.split()[0], 'debian_major': Path('/etc/debian_version').read_text().strip().split('.')[0],
                'packages_sha256': hashlib.sha256(packages.encode()).hexdigest()}
    if (target / 'runtime.json').is_file() and json.loads((target / 'runtime.json').read_text()) == identity:
        environment = {**os.environ, 'PYTHONHOME': str(target), 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH': str(target / 'lib')}
        probe = subprocess.run([str(target / 'bin/python3'), '-c', 'import ssl,sqlite3,urllib.request,tarfile,ctypes,json'], env=environment, capture_output=True)
        if probe.returncode == 0:
            print('Debian Python runtime already installed and import checks passed.', flush=True)
            return
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.python-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary) / 'ready'
        (stage / 'bin').mkdir(parents=True)
        library = stage / 'lib'; library.mkdir()
        shutil.copy2(Path(sys.executable).resolve(), stage / 'bin/python3')
        shutil.copytree(sysconfig.get_path('stdlib'), library / ('python' + sysconfig.get_python_version()),
                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__', 'site-packages', 'dist-packages', 'test', 'tests'))
        binaries = [stage / 'bin/python3', *library.rglob('*.so')]
        dependencies = set()
        for binary in binaries:
            result = subprocess.run(['ldd', str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            if result.returncode:
                raise ValueError('Cannot inspect bundled Python dependencies')
            if 'not found' in result.stdout:
                raise ValueError('Installer is missing a Python shared library')
            dependencies.update(re.findall(r'=>\s+(/[^\s]+)', result.stdout))
        # Keep the runtime image's glibc and ELF loader together.
        glibc = ('libc.so.', 'libm.so.', 'libdl.so.', 'libpthread.so.', 'librt.so.', 'libresolv.so.', 'libutil.so.')
        for name in sorted(dependencies):
            source = Path(name)
            if not source.name.startswith(glibc):
                shutil.copy2(source, library / source.name)
        notices = stage / 'licenses'; notices.mkdir()
        for source in Path('/usr/share/doc').glob('*/copyright'):
            shutil.copy2(source, notices / (source.parent.name.replace(':', '_') + '.copyright'))
        (stage / 'packages.txt').write_text(packages)
        (stage / 'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity) + '\n')
        backup = root / '.voltra' / ('python-previous-' + str(time.time_ns()))
        if target.exists():
            os.replace(target, backup)
        try:
            os.replace(stage, target)
        except BaseException:
            if backup.exists():
                os.replace(backup, target)
            raise
        # Unchanged reinstalls reuse a checked bundle. Changed packages retain
        # the previous interpreter for recovery, without touching operator data.
    print('Debian Python runtime and package notices installed.', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    bundle(Path.cwd())

import os

import tarfile

def sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1048576), b''):

    # volume before installation. Never link writable game data to a cache.
    if cache_root is None:

        cache_root = managed / 'public-cache' if managed is not None else None

        if len(digest) != 64 or any(c not in '0123456789abcdef' for c in digest):
            raise ValueError('Public native cache requires a SHA-256 identity')
        cached = cache_root / digest

            raise ValueError('Native public cache must not use symlinks')

    seen, total = set(), 0

    cache=root/'.voltra/public-cache';cache.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

        except BaseException:path.unlink(missing_ok=True);raise

def api(url):

def impostor_release(version,checksum=''):
    if version=='v1.10.9':return dict(IMPOSTOR)
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}',version):raise ValueError('Invalid VERSION')
    data=api('https://api.github.com/repos/Impostor/Impostor/releases/'+('latest' if version=='latest' else 'tags/'+urllib.parse.quote(version,safe='')))
    assets=[x for x in data.get('assets',[]) if re.fullmatch(r'Impostor-Server_[A-Za-z0-9._-]+_linux-x64\.tar\.gz',x['name'])]
    if len(assets)!=1:raise ValueError('Selected release has no unique Linux x64 server')
    asset=assets[0];digest=asset.get('digest','')
    if not re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}',digest):

    if receipt.is_file() and json.loads(receipt.read_text()).get('sha256')==identity['sha256'] and (target/executable).is_file():return
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='runtime-',dir=root/'.voltra') as temporary:
        stage=Path(temporary);release.download(identity,stage/'archive');ready=stage/'ready';ready.mkdir()
        if node_only:
            # Portable Node needs the interpreter and notices only. npm symlinks
            # are intentionally excluded; Yarn runs using the reviewed interpreter.
            wanted={'bin/node','LICENSE','README.md','CHANGELOG.md'}
            with tarfile.open(stage/'archive','r:*') as source:
                for member in source:
                    prefix=identity['prefix']+'/'
                    if not member.name.startswith(prefix):continue
                    name_=member.name[len(prefix):]
                    if name_ not in wanted:continue
                    if not member.isfile():raise ValueError('Unexpected Node runtime member')
                    path=ready/name_;path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                    with source.extractfile(member) as inp,path.open('xb') as out:shutil.copyfileobj(inp,out)

            if not (ready/executable).is_file():raise ValueError('Node runtime missing interpreter')
        else:release.extract(stage/'archive',ready,identity['prefix'])
        (ready/'voltra-release.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')
        backup=target.with_name(name+'-previous')
        if backup.exists():raise ValueError('Previous runtime recovery directory needs operator review')
        if target.exists():target.rename(backup)
        try:ready.rename(target)
        except BaseException:
            if backup.exists():backup.rename(target)

    if policy not in ('pinned','follow_branch'):raise ValueError('Invalid SOURCE_POLICY')
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_./-]{1,100}',branch) or '..' in branch:raise ValueError('Invalid BRANCH')
    if branch==CREW_COMMIT or (branch=='master' and policy=='pinned'):commit=CREW_COMMIT;digest=CREW_SHA
    else:
        commit=api('https://api.github.com/repos/OhMyGuus/BetterCrewLink-server/commits/'+urllib.parse.quote(branch,safe=''))['sha'];digest=None
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}',commit):raise ValueError('Invalid publisher commit')
    url='https://codeload.github.com/OhMyGuus/BetterCrewLink-server/tar.gz/'+commit
    if digest is None:
        # Explicit alternate branches preserve the original source-selection API.
        # Resolve one immutable commit and record its TLS-fetched source identity.
        cache=root/'.voltra/public-cache';cache.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=cache,delete=False) as out:
            path=Path(out.name)

            except BaseException:path.unlink(missing_ok=True);raise
        digest=release.sha256(path);destination=cache/digest
        if destination.exists():path.unlink()
        else:path.rename(destination)

    elif game=='crewlink':

def migrate(root,game,names):
    """Import original egg layout once without moving/deleting operator files."""
    marker=root/'.voltra'/game/'legacy-layout-imported.json'
    if marker.exists():return
    imported=[]
    for name in names:
        source=root/name;destination=root/game/name
        if not source.exists():continue
        if source.is_symlink() or not source.resolve().is_relative_to(root):raise ValueError('Legacy operator path escapes volume')
        if source.is_dir():
            if any(p.is_symlink() for p in source.rglob('*')):raise ValueError('Legacy operator directory contains symlinks; migrate manually')
            if destination.exists():raise ValueError('Legacy operator directory conflicts with installed layout: '+name)
            shutil.copytree(source,destination,copy_function=shutil.copy2)
        else:
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            if destination.exists() and name!='config.json':continue
            shutil.copy2(source,destination)
        imported.append(name)
    marker.write_text(json.dumps({'copied':imported,'source_files_retained':True},indent=2)+'\n')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Shared SteamCMD contract for imported game templates, without shell flags."""
import hashlib
from contextlib import contextmanager
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import stat
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.request

BOOTSTRAP = 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz'


@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    if root.resolve() != root or root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')
    descriptor = os.open(root, flags)
    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)
    try:
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    yield None, parts[-1], volume
                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                try:
                    if os.geteuid() == 0:
                        os.fchown(next_descriptor, volume.st_uid, volume.st_gid)
                except BaseException:
                    os.close(next_descriptor)
                    raise
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = next_descriptor
        yield descriptor, parts[-1], volume
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _publication_leaf(parent, name):
    try:
        metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise ValueError('Steam publication destination must be a regular file')
    return metadata


def _publication_check(root):
    # Run before bootstrap/SteamCMD and again after the publisher, including
    # missing leaves: existing parent components must still be confined.
    for relative in ('.voltra/steam-template-release.json',
                     '.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so', '.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):
        with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is not None:
                _publication_leaf(parent, name)


def _publish(root, relative, writer, default_mode=0o644):
    """Publish new bytes while retaining existing ownership and permissions."""
    with _publication_parent(root, relative, create=True) as (parent, name, volume):
        previous = _publication_leaf(parent, name)
        temporary, descriptor, identity = None, None, None
        try:
            for attempt in range(5):
                candidate = '.voltra-publish-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
                try:
                    descriptor = os.open(candidate, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                                         0o600, dir_fd=parent)
                    temporary = candidate
                    break
                except FileExistsError:
                    continue
            if descriptor is None:
                raise ValueError('Cannot reserve a private Steam publication file')
            identity = os.fstat(descriptor)
            with os.fdopen(os.dup(descriptor), 'wb') as output:
                writer(output)
                output.flush()
            metadata = previous or volume
            if os.geteuid() == 0:
                os.fchown(descriptor, metadata.st_uid, metadata.st_gid)
            os.fchmod(descriptor, stat.S_IMODE(previous.st_mode) if previous else default_mode)
            os.fsync(descriptor)
            with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (current, leaf, _):
                if current is None or (os.fstat(current).st_dev, os.fstat(current).st_ino) != (os.fstat(parent).st_dev, os.fstat(parent).st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication parent changed')
                latest = _publication_leaf(current, leaf)
                signature = lambda value: None if value is None else (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_mode, value.st_uid, value.st_gid, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)
                if signature(latest) != signature(previous):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication destination changed')
                candidate = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                if (candidate.st_dev, candidate.st_ino) != (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication temporary file changed')
                os.replace(temporary, name, src_dir_fd=parent, dst_dir_fd=parent)
                temporary = None
                os.fsync(parent)
            _publication_check(root)
        finally:
            if temporary is not None and identity is not None:
                # Remove only the inode reserved by this invocation. A replaced
                # or unknown name is never deleted as failure cleanup.
                try:
                    current = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                    if (current.st_dev, current.st_ino) == (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):
                        os.unlink(temporary, dir_fd=parent)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass
            if descriptor is not None:
                os.close(descriptor)


class SteamInstallError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, app_id, status, reason):
        self.app_id, self.status, self.reason = app_id, status, reason
        super().__init__('SteamCMD failed (' + reason + '); inspect the redacted installation output')


def failure_reason(output, app_id):
    clean = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', b'', output)
    expected = ("ERROR! Failed to install app '" + str(app_id) + "' (Invalid platform)").encode('ascii')
    return 'invalid_platform' if any(line.strip() == expected for line in clean.splitlines()) else 'steamcmd_failed'


def arguments(root, app_id, env, validate=True, platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    # SteamCMD reparses its argv using its own command language. Raw argv is
    # therefore not a faithful credential transport (e.g. a leading + value
    # becomes another command). Keep unverified private paths unavailable.
    if (env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '') or env.get('STEAM_PASS', '') or
            env.get('STEAM_AUTH', '') or env.get('STEAM_USER', '') not in ('', 'anonymous')):
        raise ValueError('Private Steam credentials are not enabled until native command parsing is verified')
    if not isinstance(app_id, int) or isinstance(app_id, bool) or not 1 <= app_id <= 2**31 - 1:
        raise ValueError('Choose a numeric Steam application ID')
    branch = env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '')
    if branch and not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}', branch):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam branch name')
    credentials = [env.get(name, '') for name in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH')]
    if any(value.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in value) for value in credentials):
        raise ValueError('Steam credentials cannot contain controls or begin with command prefixes')
    if credentials[0] and credentials[0] != 'anonymous':
        if not credentials[1]:
            raise ValueError('A Steam account password is required for account login')
        login = credentials[:2] + ([credentials[2]] if credentials[2] else [])
    else:
        login = ['anonymous']
    if platform not in ('linux', 'windows'):
        raise ValueError('Choose a reviewed Steam target platform')
    if not isinstance(force_platform, bool): raise ValueError('Platform selection must be an explicit boolean')
    if env.get('WINDOWS_INSTALL', '1' if platform == 'windows' else '0') != ('1' if platform == 'windows' else '0'):
        raise ValueError('Steam target platform does not match this reviewed template')
    args = [str(root / '.voltra/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh'), '+@ShutdownOnFailedCommand', '1',
            '+@NoPromptForPassword', '1', '+force_install_dir', str(root)]
    if platform == 'windows' or force_platform:
        args += ['+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType', platform]
    args += ['+login', *login,
            # Required for first installs in a cold SteamCMD metadata cache.
            '+app_info_update', '1', '+app_info_print', str(app_id)]
    if app_id == 90:
        game = env.get('HLDS_GAME', 'cstrike')
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,32}', game):
            raise ValueError('Choose a native HLDS mod directory')
        args += ['+app_set_config', '90', 'mod', game]
    args += ['+app_update', str(app_id)]
    if branch and branch != 'public':
        args += ['-beta', branch]
    beta_password = env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '')
    if beta_password:
        if not branch or branch == 'public' or beta_password.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in beta_password):
            raise ValueError('A beta password requires a selected private branch')
        args += ['-betapassword', beta_password]
    if env.get('INSTALL_FLAGS', ''):
        raise ValueError('Use typed Steam options instead of arbitrary INSTALL_FLAGS')
    if validate:
        args += ['validate']
    return args + ['+quit']


def manifest(root, app_id):
    path = root / 'steamapps' / ('appmanifest_' + str(app_id) + '.acf')
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    values = {}
    for key in ('appid', 'StateFlags', 'buildid'):
        matches = re.findall(r'"' + key + r'"\s+"([0-9]+)"', text)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Steam manifest is missing an unambiguous ' + key)
        values[key] = int(matches[0])
    if values['appid'] != app_id or values['StateFlags'] != 4 or values['buildid'] < 1:
        raise ValueError('Steam did not leave a fully installed application manifest')
    return values


class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output


def bootstrap(root):

class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break

"""MIT. Preserve native INI comments and unknown settings during managed updates."""
import os

def patch_ini(content, sections):
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in content else '\n'

    section = None

    def missing(name):
        for key, value in sections.get(name, {}).items():
            if (name, key) not in seen_keys:
                result.append(key + ' = ' + value + newline)
                seen_keys.add((name, key))

    for line in content.splitlines(keepends=True):
        header = re.fullmatch(r'\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*(?:[;#].*)?', line.strip())
        if header:
            missing(section)
            section = header.group(1)
            if section in sections and section in seen_sections:
                raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI section: ' + section)
            seen_sections.add(section)
        elif section in sections and not line.lstrip().startswith((';', '#')) and '=' in line:
            key = line.split('=', 1)[0].strip()
            if key in sections[section]:
                if (section, key) in seen_keys:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI key: ' + key)
                seen_keys.add((section, key))
                line = line.split('=', 1)[0] + '= ' + sections[section][key] + newline

            result[-1] += newline
        result.append(line)
    if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
        result[-1] += newline
    missing(section)
    for name in sections:
        if name not in seen_sections:
            result.append('[' + name + ']' + newline)

    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voltra-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as output:
            output.write(content)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):os.unlink(temporary)


def configure_ini(root, path, sections, backups):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path, backups = Path(path), Path(backups)
    if not all(p.resolve().is_relative_to(root) for p in (path, backups)):

def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):

class SteamInstallError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, app_id, status, reason):
        self.app_id, self.status, self.reason = app_id, status, reason

def failure_reason(output, app_id):
    clean = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', b'', output)
    expected = ("ERROR! Failed to install app '" + str(app_id) + "' (Invalid platform)").encode('ascii')
    return 'invalid_platform' if any(line.strip() == expected for line in clean.splitlines()) else 'steamcmd_failed'


def arguments(root, app_id, env, validate=True, platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    # SteamCMD reparses its argv using its own command language. Raw argv is
    # therefore not a faithful credential transport (e.g. a leading + value
    # becomes another command). Keep unverified private paths unavailable.
    if (env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '') or env.get('STEAM_PASS', '') or
            env.get('STEAM_AUTH', '') or env.get('STEAM_USER', '') not in ('', 'anonymous')):
        raise ValueError('Private Steam credentials are not enabled until native command parsing is verified')
    if not isinstance(app_id, int) or isinstance(app_id, bool) or not 1 <= app_id <= 2**31 - 1:
        raise ValueError('Choose a numeric Steam application ID')
    branch = env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '')
    if branch and not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}', branch):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam branch name')
    credentials = [env.get(name, '') for name in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH')]
    if any(value.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in value) for value in credentials):
        raise ValueError('Steam credentials cannot contain controls or begin with command prefixes')
    if credentials[0] and credentials[0] != 'anonymous':
        if not credentials[1]:
            raise ValueError('A Steam account password is required for account login')
        login = credentials[:2] + ([credentials[2]] if credentials[2] else [])
    else:
        login = ['anonymous']
    if platform not in ('linux', 'windows'):
        raise ValueError('Choose a reviewed Steam target platform')
    if not isinstance(force_platform, bool): raise ValueError('Platform selection must be an explicit boolean')
    if env.get('WINDOWS_INSTALL', '1' if platform == 'windows' else '0') != ('1' if platform == 'windows' else '0'):
        raise ValueError('Steam target platform does not match this reviewed template')
    args = [str(root / '.voltra/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh'), '+@ShutdownOnFailedCommand', '1',
            '+@NoPromptForPassword', '1', '+force_install_dir', str(root)]
    if platform == 'windows' or force_platform:
        args += ['+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType', platform]
    args += ['+login', *login,
            # Required for first installs in a cold SteamCMD metadata cache.
            '+app_info_update', '1', '+app_info_print', str(app_id)]
    if app_id == 90:
        game = env.get('HLDS_GAME', 'cstrike')
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,32}', game):
            raise ValueError('Choose a native HLDS mod directory')
        args += ['+app_set_config', '90', 'mod', game]
    args += ['+app_update', str(app_id)]
    if branch and branch != 'public':
        args += ['-beta', branch]
    beta_password = env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '')
    if beta_password:
        if not branch or branch == 'public' or beta_password.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in beta_password):
            raise ValueError('A beta password requires a selected private branch')
        args += ['-betapassword', beta_password]
    if env.get('INSTALL_FLAGS', ''):
        raise ValueError('Use typed Steam options instead of arbitrary INSTALL_FLAGS')
    if validate:
        args += ['validate']
    return args + ['+quit']


def manifest(root, app_id):
    path = root / 'steamapps' / ('appmanifest_' + str(app_id) + '.acf')
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    values = {}
    for key in ('appid', 'StateFlags', 'buildid'):
        matches = re.findall(r'"' + key + r'"\s+"([0-9]+)"', text)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Steam manifest is missing an unambiguous ' + key)
        values[key] = int(matches[0])
    if values['appid'] != app_id or values['StateFlags'] != 4 or values['buildid'] < 1:
        raise ValueError('Steam did not leave a fully installed application manifest')
    return values


class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output


def bootstrap(root):
    target = root / '.voltra/steamcmd'
    if target.is_symlink() or not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError('SteamCMD destination escapes the server volume')
    if (target / 'steamcmd.sh').is_file() and (target / 'linux32/steamcmd').is_file():
        return
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.steam-bootstrap-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        archive = stage / 'steamcmd.tar.gz'
        checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        with urllib.request.urlopen(BOOTSTRAP, timeout=120) as response, archive.open('xb') as output:
            if not response.geturl().startswith('https://'):
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap redirected outside HTTPS')
            while True:
                block = response.read(1048576)
                if not block:
                    break
                count += len(block)
                if count > 128 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap archive exceeds its size limit')
                checksum.update(block)
                output.write(block)
        ready = stage / 'ready'; ready.mkdir()
        seen, total = set(), 0
        with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:gz') as source:
            for member in source:
                path = PurePosixPath(member.name)
                if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or '\\' in member.name or not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()):
                    raise ValueError('Unsafe SteamCMD bootstrap archive')
                if path.as_posix() == '.':
                    continue
                if path.as_posix() in seen:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate SteamCMD bootstrap path')
                seen.add(path.as_posix()); total += member.size
                if len(seen) > 10000 or total > 512 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap expansion exceeds its limit')
                destination = ready.joinpath(*path.parts)
                if member.isdir():
                    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    with source.extractfile(member) as inp, destination.open('xb') as output:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(inp, output)
                    destination.chmod(member.mode & 0o777)
        for name in ('steamcmd.sh', 'linux32/steamcmd'):
            if not (ready / name).is_file():
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap is missing its launcher')
            (ready / name).chmod(0o755)
        if target.exists():
            raise ValueError('Incomplete existing SteamCMD folder needs operator review')
        os.replace(ready, target)
        (target.parent / 'steamcmd-bootstrap.json').write_text(json.dumps({'url': BOOTSTRAP, 'sha256': checksum.hexdigest(), 'bytes': count}) + '\n')


def update(root, app_id, env=None, validate=True, required=(), platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    supplied_root = root.absolute()
    root = root.resolve()
    env = os.environ if env is None else env
    args = arguments(root, app_id, env, validate, platform=platform, force_platform=force_platform)
    if supplied_root != root:
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume must not contain symlinks or traversal')
    _publication_check(root)
    bootstrap(root)
    _publication_check(root)
    child_env = {**os.environ, 'HOME': str(root)}
    for name in ('PYTHONHOME', 'PYTHONPATH', 'LD_PRELOAD'):
        child_env.pop(name, None)
    # The bundled Python dependency directory belongs to the helper only.
    child_env.pop('LD_LIBRARY_PATH', None)
    print('SteamCMD: refresh target metadata, then ' + ('validate/install' if validate else 'update') + ' application ' + str(app_id), flush=True)
    child = subprocess.Popen(['timeout', '--signal=TERM', '--kill-after=30s', '7200s', *args], cwd=root, env=child_env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    secrets = [env.get(key, '') for key in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH', 'SRCDS_BETAPASS')]
    redactor = Redactor(secrets)
    failure_tail = b''
    import sys
    try:
        while True:
            block = child.stdout.read1(16384)
            if not block:
                break
            failure_tail = (failure_tail + block)[-8192:]
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(redactor.feed(block)); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(redactor.feed(b'', final=True)); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        status = child.wait()
    except BaseException:
        child.terminate()
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            child.kill()
            child.wait()
        # TimeoutExpired includes the original command arguments, which can
        # contain Steam credentials. Never let that exception reach the console.
        raise RuntimeError('Steam helper interrupted; inspect the redacted output') from None
    if status != 0:
        raise SteamInstallError(app_id, status, failure_reason(failure_tail, app_id))
    _publication_check(root)
    receipt = manifest(root, app_id)
    for name in required:
        path = root / name
        if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
            raise ValueError('Steam installation lacks a required server file')
    for bits in ('32', '64'):
        with _publication_parent(root, '.voltra/steamcmd/linux' + bits + '/steamclient.so') as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is None or _publication_leaf(parent, name) is None:
                continue
            descriptor = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'rb') as source:
                metadata = os.fstat(source.fileno())
                if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
                    raise ValueError('Steam SDK source must be a regular file')
                _publish(root, '.steam/sdk' + bits + '/steamclient.so',
                         lambda output: shutil.copyfileobj(source, output), metadata.st_mode & 0o777)
    payload = (json.dumps({**receipt, 'branch': env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '') or 'public', 'platform': platform}, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
    _publish(root, '.voltra/steam-template-release.json', lambda output: output.write(payload))
    return receipt

"""MIT. Preserve native INI comments and unknown settings during managed updates."""
import os

def patch_ini(content, sections):
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in content else '\n'
    result, seen_sections, seen_keys = [], set(), set()
    section = None

    def missing(name):
        for key, value in sections.get(name, {}).items():
            if (name, key) not in seen_keys:
                result.append(key + ' = ' + value + newline)
                seen_keys.add((name, key))

    for line in content.splitlines(keepends=True):
        header = re.fullmatch(r'\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*(?:[;#].*)?', line.strip())
        if header:
            missing(section)
            section = header.group(1)
            if section in sections and section in seen_sections:
                raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI section: ' + section)
            seen_sections.add(section)
        elif section in sections and not line.lstrip().startswith((';', '#')) and '=' in line:
            key = line.split('=', 1)[0].strip()
            if key in sections[section]:
                if (section, key) in seen_keys:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI key: ' + key)
                seen_keys.add((section, key))
                line = line.split('=', 1)[0] + '= ' + sections[section][key] + newline
        if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
            result[-1] += newline
        result.append(line)
    if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
        result[-1] += newline
    missing(section)
    for name in sections:
        if name not in seen_sections:
            result.append('[' + name + ']' + newline)
            missing(name)
    return ''.join(result)

    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voltra-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as output:
            output.write(content)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):os.unlink(temporary)


def configure_ini(root, path, sections, backups):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path, backups = Path(path), Path(backups)
    if not all(p.resolve().is_relative_to(root) for p in (path, backups)):
        raise ValueError('Native configuration leaves the server volume')
    if path.exists():

    if updated != previous:

        private_write(path, updated)
    else:path.chmod(0o600)

@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')

        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')

    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)

            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:

                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)

            descriptor = next_descriptor

    finally:

                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):

class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output


def bootstrap(root):
    target = root / '.voltra/steamcmd'
    if target.is_symlink() or not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError('SteamCMD destination escapes the server volume')
    if (target / 'steamcmd.sh').is_file() and (target / 'linux32/steamcmd').is_file():
        return
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.steam-bootstrap-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        archive = stage / 'steamcmd.tar.gz'
        checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        with urllib.request.urlopen(BOOTSTRAP, timeout=120) as response, archive.open('xb') as output:
            if not response.geturl().startswith('https://'):
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap redirected outside HTTPS')

                block = response.read(1048576)

                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap archive exceeds its size limit')

                path = PurePosixPath(member.name)

                    raise ValueError('Unsafe SteamCMD bootstrap archive')
                if path.as_posix() == '.':
                    continue
                if path.as_posix() in seen:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate SteamCMD bootstrap path')
                seen.add(path.as_posix()); total += member.size
                if len(seen) > 10000 or total > 512 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap expansion exceeds its limit')
                destination = ready.joinpath(*path.parts)
                if member.isdir():
                    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

            raise ValueError('Incomplete existing SteamCMD folder needs operator review')

def update(root, app_id, env=None, validate=True, required=(), platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):

    _publication_check(root)

"""MIT. Preserve native INI comments and unknown settings during managed updates."""
import os

def patch_ini(content, sections):
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in content else '\n'
    result, seen_sections, seen_keys = [], set(), set()
    section = None

    def missing(name):
        for key, value in sections.get(name, {}).items():
            if (name, key) not in seen_keys:
                result.append(key + ' = ' + value + newline)
                seen_keys.add((name, key))

    for line in content.splitlines(keepends=True):
        header = re.fullmatch(r'\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*(?:[;#].*)?', line.strip())
        if header:
            missing(section)
            section = header.group(1)
            if section in sections and section in seen_sections:
                raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI section: ' + section)
            seen_sections.add(section)
        elif section in sections and not line.lstrip().startswith((';', '#')) and '=' in line:
            key = line.split('=', 1)[0].strip()
            if key in sections[section]:
                if (section, key) in seen_keys:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI key: ' + key)
                seen_keys.add((section, key))
                line = line.split('=', 1)[0] + '= ' + sections[section][key] + newline
        if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
            result[-1] += newline
        result.append(line)
    if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
        result[-1] += newline
    missing(section)
    for name in sections:
        if name not in seen_sections:
            result.append('[' + name + ']' + newline)
            missing(name)

    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voltra-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as output:
            output.write(content)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):os.unlink(temporary)


def configure_ini(root, path, sections, backups):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path, backups = Path(path), Path(backups)
    if not all(p.resolve().is_relative_to(root) for p in (path, backups)):
        raise ValueError('Native configuration leaves the server volume')

"""MIT. Shared SteamCMD contract for imported game templates, without shell flags."""
import hashlib

import os

import tarfile
import tempfile

@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')

        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')
    descriptor = os.open(root, flags)
    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)
    try:
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    yield None, parts[-1], volume
                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                try:
                    if os.geteuid() == 0:
                        os.fchown(next_descriptor, volume.st_uid, volume.st_gid)
                except BaseException:
                    os.close(next_descriptor)
                    raise

            descriptor = next_descriptor
        yield descriptor, parts[-1], volume
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)

    try:
        metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:

                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):

            if parent is not None:

class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Preserve native INI comments and unknown settings during managed updates."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tempfile
import time


def patch_ini(content, sections):
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in content else '\n'
    result, seen_sections, seen_keys = [], set(), set()
    section = None

    def missing(name):
        for key, value in sections.get(name, {}).items():
            if (name, key) not in seen_keys:
                result.append(key + ' = ' + value + newline)
                seen_keys.add((name, key))

    for line in content.splitlines(keepends=True):
        header = re.fullmatch(r'\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*(?:[;#].*)?', line.strip())
        if header:
            missing(section)
            section = header.group(1)
            if section in sections and section in seen_sections:
                raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI section: ' + section)
            seen_sections.add(section)
        elif section in sections and not line.lstrip().startswith((';', '#')) and '=' in line:
            key = line.split('=', 1)[0].strip()
            if key in sections[section]:
                if (section, key) in seen_keys:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI key: ' + key)
                seen_keys.add((section, key))
                line = line.split('=', 1)[0] + '= ' + sections[section][key] + newline
        if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
            result[-1] += newline
        result.append(line)
    if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
        result[-1] += newline
    missing(section)
    for name in sections:
        if name not in seen_sections:
            result.append('[' + name + ']' + newline)
            missing(name)
    return ''.join(result)


def private_write(path, content):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voltra-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as output:
            output.write(content)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):os.unlink(temporary)


def configure_ini(root, path, sections, backups):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path, backups = Path(path), Path(backups)
    if not all(p.resolve().is_relative_to(root) for p in (path, backups)):
        raise ValueError('Native configuration leaves the server volume')
    if path.exists():
        with path.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as source:previous = source.read()
    else:previous = ''
    updated = patch_ini(previous, sections)
    if updated != previous:

    else:path.chmod(0o600)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Preserve native INI comments and unknown settings during managed updates."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tempfile
import time


def patch_ini(content, sections):
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in content else '\n'
    result, seen_sections, seen_keys = [], set(), set()
    section = None

    def missing(name):
        for key, value in sections.get(name, {}).items():
            if (name, key) not in seen_keys:
                result.append(key + ' = ' + value + newline)
                seen_keys.add((name, key))

    for line in content.splitlines(keepends=True):
        header = re.fullmatch(r'\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*(?:[;#].*)?', line.strip())
        if header:
            missing(section)
            section = header.group(1)
            if section in sections and section in seen_sections:
                raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI section: ' + section)
            seen_sections.add(section)
        elif section in sections and not line.lstrip().startswith((';', '#')) and '=' in line:
            key = line.split('=', 1)[0].strip()
            if key in sections[section]:
                if (section, key) in seen_keys:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI key: ' + key)
                seen_keys.add((section, key))
                line = line.split('=', 1)[0] + '= ' + sections[section][key] + newline
        if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
            result[-1] += newline
        result.append(line)
    if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
        result[-1] += newline
    missing(section)
    for name in sections:
        if name not in seen_sections:
            result.append('[' + name + ']' + newline)
            missing(name)
    return ''.join(result)


def private_write(path, content):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voltra-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as output:
            output.write(content)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):os.unlink(temporary)


def configure_ini(root, path, sections, backups):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path, backups = Path(path), Path(backups)
    if not all(p.resolve().is_relative_to(root) for p in (path, backups)):
        raise ValueError('Native configuration leaves the server volume')
    if path.exists():

def private_bytes(path, content, metadata=None):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voltra-',dir=path.parent)
    try:

installation.script:
# Install required packages
apt update
apt install -y lsb-release xvfb unzip jq

# Install wine
wget -O /etc/apt/keyrings/winehq-archive.key https://dl.winehq.org/wine-builds/winehq.key
wget -NP /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ https://dl.winehq.org/wine-builds/debian/dists/$(lsb_release -sc 2>/dev/null)/winehq-$(lsb_release -sc 2>/dev/null).sources
apt update
apt install --no-install-recommends winehq-stable cabextract -y

export WINEPREFIX=/root/.wine
mkdir -p $WINEPREFIX


# Setup display
export DISPLAY=:0
Xvfb :0 -screen 0 1024x768x16 &




# Install Winetricks
echo "Installing winetricks"
wget -q -O /usr/sbin/winetricks https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Winetricks/winetricks/master/src/winetricks && chmod +x /usr/sbin/winetricks

echo "Installing mono"
wget -q -O $WINEPREFIX/mono.msi https://dl.winehq.org/wine/wine-mono/9.1.0/wine-mono-9.1.0-x86.msi
WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml=" wine msiexec /i $WINEPREFIX/mono.msi /qn /quiet /norestart /log $WINEPREFIX/mono_install.log

# Install dotnet
echo "Installing dotnet"
winetricks -q dotnet10           


# Setup tty width so wine console output doesn't prematurely wrap
stty columns 250


cd /mnt/server || { echo "Failed to change directory"; exit 1; }

# Install lip
LIP_VERSION="$(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/futrime/lip/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name[1:]')"
LIP_URL="https://github.com/futrime/lip/releases/download/v${LIP_VERSION}/lip-${LIP_VERSION}-win-x64.zip"
wget "$LIP_URL" -O lip.zip
unzip -o lip.zip lip.exe
rm lip.zip


if [ -n "$VERSION" ] && [ "$VERSION" != "latest" ]; then
    wine lip.exe install github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLamina@"$VERSION"
else
    wine lip.exe install github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLamina
fi


echo "Server Installed"

if [ -f "lip-install.txt" ]; then
    for package in $(cat "lip-install.txt" ); do
        echo "Installing ${package} from lip-install.txt"
        wine lip.exe install "${package}"
    done
    echo "Packages installed"
fi

LiteLoaderBDS - Epoch-making & Cross-language Bedrock Dedicated Servers Plugin Loader

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Liteloader First-time Install Script

apk update
apk add gzip jq curl wine
cd /mnt/server

for file in *; do
    if [ "$file" != "allowlist.json" ] && [ "$file" != "permissions.json" ] && [ "$file" != "server.properties" ] && [ "$file" != "plugins" ] && [ "$file" != "world" ]; then
        if [ -d "$file" ]; then
            rm -rf "$file"  # Remove directories recursively
        else
            rm "$file"  # Remove files
        fi
    fi
done

# Download Minecraft BDS
RANDVERSION=$(echo $((1 + $RANDOM % 4000)))

if [ -z "${BDS_VERSION}" ] || [ "${BDS_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo -e "\n Downloading latest Bedrock server"
    curl -L -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/90.0.$RANDVERSION.212 Safari/537.36" -H "Accept-Language: en" -H "Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate" -o versions.html.gz https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/download/server/bedrock
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(zgrep -o 'https://minecraft.azureedge.net/bin-win/[^"]*' versions.html.gz)
else 
    echo -e "\n Downloading ${BDS_VERSION} Bedrock server"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=https://minecraft.azureedge.net/bin-win/bedrock-server-$BDS_VERSION.zip
fi

DOWNLOAD_FILE=$(echo ${DOWNLOAD_URL} | cut -d"/" -f5) # Retrieve archive name

echo -e "Downloading files from: $DOWNLOAD_URL"

curl -L -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/90.0.$RANDVERSION.212 Safari/537.36" -H "Accept-Language: en" -o $DOWNLOAD_FILE $DOWNLOAD_URL

echo -e "Unpacking server files"
unzip -o $DOWNLOAD_FILE

echo -e "Cleaning up after installing"
rm $DOWNLOAD_FILE
rm versions.html.gz


LATEST_JSON=$(curl --silent "https://api.github.com/repos/LiteLDev/LiteLoaderBDS/releases/latest")
RELEASES=$(curl --silent "https://api.github.com/repos/LiteLDev/LiteLoaderBDS/releases")

if [ -z "${LL_VERSION}" ] || [ "${LL_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo -e "\n Downloading latest LiteLoaderBDS from GitHub"
    DOWNLOAD_GIT_URL=$(echo ${LATEST_JSON} | jq .assets | jq -r .[].browser_download_url | head -1)
else
    VERSION_CHECK=$(echo ${RELEASES} | jq -r --arg VERSION "${VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name==$VERSION) | .tag_name')
    if [ "${LL_VERSION}" == "${VERSION_CHECK}" ]; then
        echo -e "\n Downloading ${LL_VERSION} LiteLoaderBDS from GitHub"
        DOWNLOAD_GIT_URL=$(echo ${RELEASES} | jq -r --arg VERSION "${LL_VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name==$LL_VERSION) | .assets[].browser_download_url' | head -1)
    else
        echo -e "defaulting to latest release"
        DOWNLOAD_GIT_URL=$(echo ${LATEST_JSON} | jq .assets | jq -r .[].browser_download_url | head -1)
    fi
fi

curl -sSL -o LiteLoader.zip ${DOWNLOAD_GIT_URL}
unzip -o LiteLoader.zip
mv -f LiteLoaderBDS/* /mnt/server
rm LiteLoader.zip
timeout 30s wine PeEditor.exe
rm -rf '/root/.wine' /mnt/server/LiteLoaderBDS/

# Downloading Launcher and finishing touches
wget https://io.ivampiresp.com/d/Software/MCServer/BDS/LiteLoader/lae-ll-launcher
chmod +x lae-ll-launcher
echo "Finished Downloading Liteloader..."
